Heh? You brought all the items~

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Phew! There you go.
Now you can wear
Black Cat Ears
of your very own~
scripts.translation:
[貓貓]
呼！完成了。
現在你可以戴上屬於你自己的黑貓耳朵了~

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Thank you for using my service~!
scripts.translation:
[貓貓]
感謝使用我的服務~！

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Umm...?
Excuse me?
Do I know you?...
Oh, I know why you
want to talk to me.
Heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[貓貓]
嗯...？
請問？
我認識你嗎？...
哦，我知道你為什麼想和我說話了。
嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
You want to know where I got these tiny little cute black cat ears on my head, don't you? I knew it! Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[貓貓]
你是想知道我頭上這雙可愛小巧的黑貓耳朵是從哪裡來的，對吧？我就知道！哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Well, I made these myself.
If you want, I can make one for you too for a small price.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓貓]
嗯，這些是我自己做的。
如果你想要的話，只要一點點錢，我也可以為你做一個。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Just bring me
1 ^FF0000Kitty Band^000000,
1 ^FF0000Black Dyestuffs^000000,
200 ^FF0000Fluff^000000 and
^FF000010,000 zeny^000000!

[Neko Neko]
^FF0000Just remember, if you bring me any item that has a card inserted, or has been upgraded, the additional abilities of the item will disappear after I have used them. So please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[貓貓]
^FF0000請記住，如果你給我任何插了卡片或經過強化的物品，在我使用之後，這些附加能力將會消失。所以請務必留意這一點。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Hey~ why are you carrying so many items?
You mind sharing them with me?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
嘿~ 你身上怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
介意分我一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Man, oh man~
Am I bored~!
If I only knew more tricks with this yo-yo. Then I could really impress the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
天哪，天哪~
我好無聊~！
要是我能學會更多悠悠球的技巧就好了。那樣我就能真正迷倒女士們了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Impress the ladies...?

[Argen]
Yeah dude. There are two things chicks dig. Small, adorable presents. And suave dudes.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
沒錯，兄弟。女生喜歡兩樣東西。小巧可愛的禮物。還有風度翩翩的帥哥。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
So, I got the cutesy present junk down. You know, instead of like, spending money on like a real gift, I make these little hairpin thingees.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
所以，我擅長準備那種可愛的禮物。你知道的，與其花大錢買真正的禮物，我更喜歡做這種小發飾。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
As for being suave? Well, I do have this yo-yo...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
至於風度翩翩嘛？嗯，我確實有個悠悠球...

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Heh. You look like you don't like wasting cash on girls either. I'm down with that. If you like, I can make you a hairpin that you can give as gifts to the ^FF3333ladies^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
嘿。看起來你也不喜歡把錢花在女生身上。我理解你。如果你願意，我可以給你做一個髮飾，你可以把它作為禮物送給 ^FF3333女士們^000000。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
All you gotta do is bring me the stuff to make it. And if that hairpin's for yourself, well, I'm down with that jive too.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
你只需要把做髮飾的材料帶給我就行。如果那個髮飾是給你自己用的，嗯，我也沒意見。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Whoa~! A lady...
Wow, you're really cute! Tell you what...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
哇~！一位女士...
哇，你真可愛！這樣吧...

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Since you're such a cutie, I'll put together a nice little hairpin for you. All you gotta do is bring me the stuff to make it.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
既然你這麼可愛，我就為你做一個漂亮的小發飾吧。你只需要把做髮飾的材料帶給我就行。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
So go ahead and tell me what kinda hairpin you're interested in.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
那麼，告訴我你想做哪種髮飾吧。

scripts.text: ^3131FFX Hairpin^000000
^3131FFBand Aid^000000
^3131FFFlower Hairpin^000000
No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Argen]
X Hairpin!
Nice choice~!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
X字髮夾！
好眼光~！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Ah... Right.
About the Stellar...
^CE3100If you use an upgraded Stellar to make this item, any upgrades will be lost. That okay with you?^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
啊...對了。
關於星石...
^CE3100如果你使用升級過的星石來製作這個物品，升級效果將會消失。這樣可以嗎？^000000

scripts.text: I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 沒關係

scripts.text: I will come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Alright, let's get to work.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
好的，開工了。

scripts.text:
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000

[Argen]
Alright, I'm done!
So what do you think?
Pretty cool, eh?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
好了，完成了！
你覺得怎麼樣？
挺酷的吧？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
No problem, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
沒問題，慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Oh~
You want a ^3131FFX Hairpin?^000000
That's easy!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
哦~
你想要一個^3131FFX字髮夾^000000？
這很簡單！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
I need ^FF00001 Stellar^000000
and ^FF0000400 Ectoplasm^000000.
Tell me when you're ready!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
我需要 ^FF00001個星石^000000和^FF0000400個幽靈^000000。
準備好了就告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Band Aid, eh?
Got it! Hold on
a sec, I'll be
done in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
創可貼，是嗎？
明白了！稍等一下，我馬上就好。

scripts.text:
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000

[Argen]
*Whew~!*
I'm finished!
Pretty cool, huh?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
*呼~！*
完成了！
挺酷的吧？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Ah, a ^3131FFBand Aid^000000!
That stuff is great for faking injuries, or hiding a bald spot. Handy to have when you wanna ditch school.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
啊，是 ^3131FF創可貼^000000！
這東西用來假裝受傷或者遮住禿頂都很棒。想逃課的時候用得上。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Bring me ^FF00001 Alcohol^000000 and
^FF0000500 Rotten Bandage^000000!
Tell me when you're ready, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
給我 ^FF00001個酒精^000000 和^FF0000500個腐爛繃帶^000000！
準備好了告訴我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
You wanna a Flower Hairpin~?
Alright, gimmie a minute, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
你想要一個花卉髮夾~？
好的，給我一分鐘，好嗎？

scripts.text:
^3131FF - Scrape Scrape - ^000000
^3131FF - Scrape Scrape - ^000000

[Argen]
Ah... It's done!
Hey, that looks pretty smooth! Oh, and uh, you can keep this leftover Stem.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
啊...完成了！
嘿，看起來挺光滑的！哦，對了，這根剩下的莖你可以留著。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
You wanna a ^3131FFFlower Hairpin^000000!
Yeah, I've noticed cuties just love walking around with flowers in their mouths, and I was always like 'Whaaaat~?' But then I got this great idea!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
你想要一個^3131FF花卉髮夾^000000！
沒錯，我注意到可愛的女生們就喜歡嘴裡叼著花到處走，我一直都在想“這都什麼呀~？”不過後來我靈機一動，想到了個好主意！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Wouldn't some kinda... ^3131FFFlower Hairpin^000000 be a hit with chicks? So I tried making one, and it seemed to be pretty popular among my lady friends.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
要是做個^3131FF花卉髮夾^000000 之類的，肯定很受歡迎吧？所以我試著做了一個，結果在我那些女性朋友中還挺火的。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
And it's a much better way to use a flower than to put it on Pet Orc Warriors. Man, those things just look gnarly~
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
而且，比起把花插在寵物獸人戰士頭上，這絕對是更好的用法。天哪，那樣看起來太噁心了~

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Well, if you want one, I'll make it. But I want you should pay me some royalties for my services. It's pretty hard to attach a flower to a hairpin, you know?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
好吧，如果你想要的話，我就給你做一個。不過你得付我一點服務費，畢竟把花固定在髮夾上挺難的，你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
It takes mad skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
這可是需要高超技巧的。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
So, I want you to bring...
^FF00001 Romantic Flower^000000,
^FF000010 Steel^000000
and ^3131FF20,000 zeny^000000!
Got it? Cool~

[Argen]
I'm down with that.
If you want some kinda hairpin, just come back. I'll just be here, looking ^FF3333suaaave^000000 with this yo-yo.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
沒問題。
如果你想要髮夾，隨時回來找我。我就在這裡，拿著悠悠球，擺著 ^FF3333超帥^000000 的姿勢。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Feel free to come ask me if you want more hairpins. Hey, I know I look lazy, but I do like to make things for the ladies. See ya later~!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾根]
如果你想要更多髮夾，儘管來找我。嘿，我知道我看起來有點懶散，但我確實喜歡為女士們製作東西。回頭見~！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
What's this?!
You've already brought everything I've asked! Good job, hero~! Let me get to work right away...
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
這是什麼？！
你已經把我要求的東西都帶來了！幹得好，英雄~！讓我馬上開始工作...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
...
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
......

[Zhenbolt]
......*Cling*

[Zhenbolt]
Take this...
It's known as the ^FF0000Hot-blooded Headband^000000, my personal symbol of fighting spirit! With this on your head, nothing can stop you!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
拿著這個...
這就是 ^FF0000熱血髮圈^000000，我戰鬥精神的象徵！戴上它，沒有什麼能阻擋你！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Now, go!
Unleash your fighting spirit upon the villains of the world!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
現在，去吧！
向世間的惡棍們釋放你的戰鬥精神吧！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
I...
am called ^FF0000Zhenbolt^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
我...
就是 ^FF0000振博爾特^000000！！

scripts.text: THE Zhenbolt!?
scripts.translation: 是振博爾特？！

scripts.text: Oh my gosh, it's Zhenbolt!
scripts.translation: 天哪，是振博爾特！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Yes, it is I, the man who has pummelled over a trillion foes and rising. Raging Hurricane Hero of Justice: Zhenbolt!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
沒錯，就是我，擊敗的敵人已超過一萬億、而且還在不斷增加的男人。狂暴颶風正義英雄：振博爾特！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
I see in your eyes that you also fight with a heart of purity, a heart of passion!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
我從你的眼中看到，你也擁有一顆純潔的心，一顆充滿激情的心！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
It is decided! If you bring me the following items, I will give you the famous symbol of battle by which villains fear Zhenbolt.
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
決定了！如果你能帶給我以下物品，我就把那個讓惡棍們聞風喪膽的著名戰鬥象徵——振博爾特的標誌給你。

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Bring me...
300 ^FF0000Red Muffler^000000,
300 ^FF0000Burning Heart^000000,
1 ^FF0000Bandana^000000 and 1 ^FF0000White Dyestuffs^000000.
That's all I need.
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
給我帶來...
300個^FF0000紅色圍巾^000000，300個^FF0000燃燒的心臟^000000，1個^FF0000方頭巾^000000 和 1個^FF0000白色染料^000000。
只要這些就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Come back soon, adventurer!
I expect great things of you!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
快點回來，冒險者！
我對你寄予厚望！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Yes.
It is I, Zhenbolt.
Warrior of Might!
Whirling Tempest
of Raging Passion!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
沒錯。
是我，振博爾特。
力量之戰士！
狂暴激情的旋風風暴！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
I see in your eyes that you have seen many a skirmish. To have survived this long, you must know the secret to victory...
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
我從你的眼中看出，你經歷過無數戰鬥。能存活至今，你一定知道勝利的秘訣...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Pure, unbridled rage!
Battles are won with vigor and passion!
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
純粹、不受束縛的憤怒！
戰鬥是靠活力和激情贏得的！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Seeing as you understand this fundamental, I recognize you as an ally in the eternal struggle for justice! I shall bestow upon you the very symbol with which I have struck fear into evil hearts...
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
既然你理解了這個根本，我承認你是正義永恆鬥爭中的盟友！我將賜予你那個讓我在邪惡心中種下恐懼的象徵...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Bring me
300 ^FF0000Red Muffler^000000,
300 ^FF0000Burning Heart^000000,
1 ^FF0000Bandana^000000 and 1 ^FF0000White Dyestuffs^000000.
That's all I need.
scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
給我帶來300個^FF0000紅色圍巾^000000，300個^FF0000燃燒的心臟^000000，1個^FF0000方頭巾^000000 和 1個^FF0000白色染料^000000。
只要這些就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Bring me those items...

scripts.translation:
[振博爾特]
把這些物品帶給我...
你也能成為戰鬥的傳奇...

哦...

...

[Nephia]
Hopefully, we can get together and do each other's hair sometime! Wouldn't that be soooo much fun?
scripts.translation:
[內菲婭]
希望我們以後能聚在一起互相做髮型！那一定非常非常有趣！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Wow~

哇~
這麼漂亮的頭髮！抱歉，我只是太喜歡漂亮的髮型和配飾了！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Ooh~! You know what would make your hair so much cuter? I think if you tied it back with a big, red ribbon, you would look sooo ^FF66CCadorable^000000!
scripts.translation:
[內菲婭]
噢~！你知道什麼能讓你的頭髮更可愛嗎？我覺得如果你用一條大大的紅色髮帶紮起來，你會看起來非常^FF66CC可愛^000000！

scripts.text: Um, lady, I'm a dude.
scripts.translation: 呃，女士，我是個男的

scripts.translation: ^FF66CC噢~！你說得對！^000000

[{0}]

[{0}]
女士，難道看不出我是個男人嗎？

scripts.translation:
[內菲婭]
哎呀...

[{0}]
That...

compliment anyone

[{0}]
這...
是我聽過的最糟糕的讚美了。

[{0}]
Oooh~!
That sounds great!

[{0}]
噢~！
聽起來很棒！

Like, oh my God! That's what I was thinking! Oh hey~! I can go ahead and tie that ribbon for you if you want!

[內菲婭]
天哪！我就是這麼想的！嘿~！如果你願意的話，我現在就可以幫你把髮帶繫好！

[Nephia]
Ooh! Bring...
1 ^FF0000Big Ribbon^000000,

^FF0000If you bring me any upgraded items, or items compounded with cards, those cards and upgrades will be lost once I create the new item for you. So please don't forget that!^000000

[內菲婭]
哎呀，我差點忘了！
^FF0000如果你給我帶來任何升級過的物品，或者鑲嵌了卡片的物品，一旦我為你製作新物品，這些卡片和升級效果將會丟失。所以請千萬不要忘記這一點！^000000

[Nephia]
Ooh, hurry hurry! I can't wait to accessorize your hair!
scripts.translation:
[內菲婭]

哇！你真的獨自收集了這300個香菇芽孢嗎？太棒了！現在該使用我的魔法了~

scripts.text:

Ipore pours the Mushroom Spores onto your head.^000000

伊波雷將香菇芽孢撒在你的頭上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
Hocus pocus!
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
變變變！

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
.......................
Phew! Success! There's a mushroom growing out of your head!

[Ipore]

I don't like the way it's tilting. It should have grown in the ^FF3333other^000000 direction.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
但是...
我不喜歡它傾斜的樣子。它應該朝^FF3333另一個方向^000000生長才對。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]

I guess we should make that mushroom into a headband so that you can adjust it to your style.

[伊波雷]
我想...
我想我們應該把這朵蘑菇做成髮圈，這樣你就可以根據自己的風格來調整它了。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
I know, I know...
It's not as cool as having the mushroom actually attached to your skull, but it's all we can do. I'm sorry I let you down.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
我知道，我知道...
這不像蘑菇直接長在頭骨上那麼酷，但這也是我們唯一能做的了。抱歉讓你失望了。

[Ipore]

scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]

完成了。不過你沒事吧？幸好，我覺得我沒有把你頭皮削掉。

[Ipore]

[伊波雷]
總之，現在你可以以瀟灑的角度戴著那朵蘑菇了，這才是它該有的戴法。保持酷勁吧，你這位時尚叛逆者。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
Finally...
I've created a magic spell that can make mushrooms grow anywhere! Anyplace you can imagine, I can make a mushroom grow there.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
終於...
我創造了一個能讓蘑菇在任何地方生長的魔法！任何你能想像的地方，我都能讓蘑菇在那裡生長。

[Ipore]
Even...
On top of the human head...
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
甚至...
在人的頭頂上...

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
Some may think it grotesque, but wouldn't you agree that sporting a mushroom, grown from your head, would start an art revolution?
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
有些人可能覺得這很怪誕，但你不覺得頭上長出一朵蘑菇，能掀起一場藝術革命嗎？

[Ipore]

Man and mushroom?
Ah...I've piqued your curiosity I see.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
想想看！這是魔法與藝術、時尚與生活的完美融合...
人與蘑菇？
啊...看來我勾起了你的好奇心。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]

[伊波雷]
所以...
但是為了施展這個魔法，我需要^FF0000300個香菇芽孢^000000中的魔力。所以，如果你把這些香菇芽孢都帶給我，你就能親眼看到我的魔法了！

scripts.text:
[Ipore]

scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
好了好了，你應該明白，我必須讓蘑菇從你的頭上長出來。如果長在其他地方，你可能會懷疑其中有什麼把戲或幻覺。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]

[伊波雷]
而且，沒有什麼比頭上長出一朵蘑菇更能體現“無因之反叛”了！你會看起來超級酷，獨立且反主流文化！

^FF0000300 Mushroom Spore^000000,

scripts.translation:

記住，帶給我...
^FF0000300個香菇芽孢^000000，這樣我就能讓你親身體驗我驚人的魔法了~！

哦？看來你身上帶著一些值錢的東西。

毫無疑問，戴著這些時尚飾品的你，會成為整個城鎮的話題。

scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
哈？有什麼好想的？！我本來打算拿出全部手藝為你打造一件特別的作品的。唉，算了...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Aha~ Good good good.
Let's see let's see...
1 Devil Wing
1 Elven Ears...
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
啊哈~ 好，好，好。
讓我看看，讓我看看...
1個惡魔髮圈
1個妖精長耳朵飾...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Some other crap and
...20,000 zeny.
I must say this is a very cheap price to pay for such a great item. But before I start, I should tell you...
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
還有一些其他破爛...以及20,000 Zeny。
不得不說，對於這麼棒的物品來說，這個價格非常便宜。不過在我開始之前，我得告訴你...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I don't care how many times you've upgraded the items you brought, but please ^4d4dff carry only items that you need to create this item. I can't mess up my artwork because of some mistake you might make. ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
不管你帶來的物品強化了多少次，請^4d4dff只攜帶製作該物品所需的材料。我不能因為你可能犯的錯誤而搞砸我的藝術品。^000000

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Okay, let me go store my other items first.
scripts.translation: 好的，讓我先去把其他物品存起來

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Ouch, why are you carrying
so many items with you?
Leave all your extra baggage somewhere else and come back.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
哎呀，你為什麼帶著這麼多物品？
把多餘的行李都放到別處，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Alright...
Let's get a groove on!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
好了...
讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
There you go, buddy.
I am proud to say this is my masterpiece. Please take this item. I call it... 'Devil Wing Ears!'
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
好了，夥計。
我很自豪地說，這是我的傑作。請收下這個物品。我把它叫做...“惡魔翅膀耳飾”！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
You'll be wowing everyone on the streets with your fashionable new look that says 'It feels so good to be so bad.' Glad to be of service~!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
你這一身時髦的新造型，絕對會讓街上所有人都驚歎不已，彷彿在說“壞得如此有型，感覺真棒”。很高興能為您服務~！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I'm sorry buddy, but I can't make this item without having the things I need. Remember, I need 1 Devil Wing, 1 Elven Ears and 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
抱歉，夥計，沒有材料我沒法制作這個物品。記住，我需要1個惡魔髮圈、1個妖精長耳朵飾和20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
No problem.
Come back anytime you want.
I'll just be here enjoying the view.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
沒問題。
隨時歡迎回來。
我就在這裡欣賞風景。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Of course, I can make an item
out of an Angel Wing as well!
That sort of thing is simple for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
當然，我也可以用天使髮圈來製作物品！
對我來說，這種事很簡單！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Okay then, then I'll need...
1 Angel Wing,
1 Elven Ears,
...and 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
那麼，我需要...
1個天使髮圈，1個妖精長耳朵飾，...還有20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I must say this is a very cheap price considering the item I will make for you. But before I start, I should tell you...
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
考慮到我要為你製作的物品，不得不說這個價格非常便宜。不過在我開始之前，我得告訴你...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I don't care how many times you've upgraded the items you brought, but please ^4d4dff carry only items that you need to create this item.^000000 I can't mess up my artwork because of some mistake you might make.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
不管你把帶來的物品強化了多少次，請^4d4dff只攜帶製作這件物品所需的物品^000000。我可不能因為你的失誤而毀了我的傑作。

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Okay, let me go store my other items first.
scripts.translation: 好的，讓我先去把其他物品存起來

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Ouch, why are you carrying
so many items with you?
Leave all your extra baggage somewhere else and come back.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
哎呀，你為什麼帶著這麼多物品？
把多餘的行李都放到別處，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
Alright...
Let's get a groove on!
scripts.translation:
好的...
讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
There you go, buddy.
I am proud to say this is my masterpiece. Please take this item. I call it... 'Angel Wing Ears!'
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
好了，夥計。
我很自豪地說，這是我的傑作。請收下這個物品。我把它叫做...“天使翅膀耳飾”！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
There's no doubt that you'll be the talk of the town sporting these fashionable things.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
毫無疑問，戴著這些時尚飾品的你，會成為整個城鎮的話題。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
The glamour of an angel and the cuteness of Elven Ears is almost too much goodness for one headgear~!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
天使的光彩加上妖精長耳朵飾的可愛，簡直好過頭了~！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I'm sorry buddy, but I can't make this item without having the things I need. Remember, I need 1 Angel Wing, 1 Elven Ears and 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
抱歉，夥計，沒有我需要的材料，我沒法制作這件物品。記住，我需要1個天使髮圈、1個妖精長耳朵飾和20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
No problem.
Come back anytime you want.
 
I'll just be here enjoying the view.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
沒問題。
隨時歡迎回來。
 
我就在這裡欣賞風景。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I happened to come to Juno while I was traveling around the world. Being someplace up in the clouds makes me a little nervous, but still, the scenery looks great from up here.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
我在環遊世界時偶然來到了朱諾。雖然身處雲端讓我有點緊張，但這裡的風景確實很棒。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Although I really enjoy traveling more than staying in my shop, I'm still a Blacksmith at heart and I always gotta be making something. It's been a while since I've made my last creation...
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
雖然我更喜歡旅行而不是待在店裡，但我骨子裡還是個鐵匠，總得做點什麼。距離我上次創作已經有一段時間了...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Hmm...
If I had some materials, I think I could put together some pretty amazing stuff.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
嗯...
如果我有材料的話，我覺得可以打造出相當驚豔的作品。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
If by any chance, you have an Angel Wing or Evil Wing, and
Elven Ears, would you give me a chance to smith something?
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
如果你碰巧有天使髮圈或惡魔髮圈，以及妖精長耳朵飾，能給我個機會打造點東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I was thinking...
Elven Ears are great...
And everyone loves Angel Wing or Devil Wing. Wouldn't it be totally fab if I could combine the Elven Ears with one of the wings?!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
我在想...
妖精長耳朵飾很棒...
而且大家都喜歡天使髮圈或惡魔髮圈。如果我能把妖精長耳朵飾和其中一種髮圈結合起來，那該多酷啊！

scripts.text: Give me more information.
scripts.translation: 給我更多資訊

scripts.text: Yeah, I will think about it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Oh, right.
Let me tell
you exactly I need.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
哦，對了。
讓我告訴你我具體需要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
For creating Angel Wing Ears, I need 1 ^4d4dffAngel Wing^000000,
1 ^4d4dffElven Ears^000000 and
^4d4dff20,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
要打造天使翅膀耳飾，我需要1個^4d4dff天使髮圈^000000，1個^4d4dff妖精長耳朵飾^000000，以及^4d4dff20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
For creating Devil Wing Ears,
I need 1 ^4d4dffDevil Wing^000000,
1 ^4d4dffElven Ears^000000 and
^4d4dff20,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
要打造惡魔翅膀耳飾，我需要1個^4d4dff惡魔髮圈^000000，1個^4d4dff妖精長耳朵飾^000000，以及^4d4dff20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Come back anytime when you have those materials.
I will let you have either the elegance of an angel or the charisma of a demon with the wearables only I can craft.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
等你準備好材料後，隨時回來找我。
我會讓你擁有隻有我能打造的飾品，讓你盡顯天使的優雅或惡魔的魅力。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
No problem.
I'm always here at this scenic spot so I can enjoy the view. Just come back whenever you feel like it.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比爾·莫爾]
沒問題。
我一直在這個風景優美的地方，可以欣賞美景。你想什麼時候回來都行。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你身上攜帶的物品太多了。請先將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I know you brought everything you need for me to make you a hat, but you're carrying too much stuff. Why don't you put some of your things in Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
我知道你帶齊了給我做帽子所需的所有材料，但你身上帶的東西太多了。為什麼不把一些東西存進卡普拉倉庫呢？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Whoa~
You brought everything!
Okay, hold on a bit.
Let me make your hat.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
哇~
你全都帶來了！
好的，請稍等。
讓我來給你做帽子。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
As my mom taught me,
put this down on the ground...
Okay, I am ready...
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
就像我媽媽教我的那樣，把這個放在地上...
好了，我準備好了...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Lindsay put the Raccoon Hat on the ground, threw the Smokie Leaf onto the hat and mumbled some words while hugging herself.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000林賽把狸貓帽放在地上，將變身樹葉扔在帽子上，然後抱著自己小聲唸了幾句咒語。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Then, suddenly with a dazzling light, the Raccoon Hat turned blue and slowly transformed into a Sea-Otter Hat.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000接著，突然閃過一道耀眼的光芒，狸貓帽變成了藍色，並慢慢變成了一頂海獺帽。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Phew! It's done!
Gosh! I think I
spent all my energy.
Okay, take this~
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
呼！完成了！
天哪！我覺得我把所有力氣都用光了。
好了，給你~

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I made this hat with all my heart, so you gotta promise me you will take care of this, okay?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
這頂帽子是我用心製作的，所以你一定要答應我好好珍惜它，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Hello, there?
Mister...?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
你好？
先生...？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
You look like you're freezing...
Um, I know! How about I make you a cute, warm and fuzzy Sea-Otter hat?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
你看起來好像很冷...
嗯，我知道了！要不要我給你做一頂可愛又溫暖的海獺帽？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
It's really really cute! Also, it's the only hat I know how to make, because I love playing with Sea Otters so much!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
它真的超級可愛！而且，這是我唯一會做的帽子，因為我非常喜歡和海獺玩耍！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I have to put together ^0000FF1 Raccoon Hat^000000 and ^0000FF1 Smokie Leaf^000000 to make a ^4D4DFFSea-Otter Hat^000000 for you, though.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
不過，我需要把^0000FF1個狸貓帽^000000和^0000FF1片變身樹葉^000000組合起來，才能為你打造一頂^4D4DFF海獺帽^000000。

scripts.text: Okay, I will come back with the stuff.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會帶著材料回來的

scripts.text: Um... How come you need a Raccoon Hat?
scripts.translation: 嗯...為什麼你需要狸貓帽？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Cool~! Come back soon as you can~!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
酷~！儘快回來哦~！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Well, it's supposed to be a seeeecret, but my mommy taught me some magic to make Sea-Otter hats with Raccoon hats.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
雖然這本來是個秘密啦，但我媽媽教了我一種魔法，可以用狸貓帽做出海獺帽。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
It's the bestest magic ever because it comes from my heart!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
這是最棒的魔法，因為它出自我的真心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That...
That still doesn't explain anything!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這...這根本解釋不通啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright...
Yeah...
I'll come back later, kid.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...行吧...我晚點再回來，小傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Hello, hello~!
You're such a pretty lady!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
你好，你好~！
你真是位漂亮的女士！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Hey hey! Can I make you a Sea-Otter hat! It's really really really really cute!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
嘿！我可以為你做一頂海獺帽嗎？它真的超級超級超級超級可愛！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I need ^0000FF1 Raccoon Hat^000000 and ^0000FF1 Smokie Leaf^000000 so I can make a ^4D4DFFSea-Otter Hat^000000 for you.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
我需要^0000FF1個狸貓帽^000000和^0000FF1片變身樹葉^000000，才能為你打造一頂^4D4DFF海獺帽^000000。

scripts.text: Okay, I will come back with the stuff.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會帶著材料回來的

scripts.text: Um, why do you want to make hats so much?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你為什麼這麼想做帽子？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Cool~!
Come back as
soon as you can~!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
酷~！
儘快回來哦~！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Because...!
If everyone in Lutie was wearing a fuzzy Sea-Otter cap, it would look so so cute!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
因為...！
如果薑餅城的每個人都戴著毛茸茸的海獺帽，那一定超級超級可愛！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
We could play games in the snow, and play with real Sea Otters and have them give us rides and...
.....
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林賽]
我們可以在雪地裡玩遊戲，還可以和真正的海獺玩耍，讓它們載我們兜風，還有...

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你身上攜帶的物品太多了。請先將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
You brought every material I need, but unfortunately you don't have enough space in your inventory. Try and place some of your items into Kafra Storage first.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
你帶來了所有我需要的材料，但不幸的是你的物品欄空間不足。請先將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Excellent! You brought everything! Please make yourself comfortable while I make you your Teddybear Hat.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
太好了！你帶來了所有材料！請坐好，我要開始為你製作小熊帽了。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Hmm Hm Hmm...
Tear this off...
Knit this on....
Okay, it's almost done...
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
嗯哼嗯哼...
把這裡拆下來...
把這裡縫上去....
好了，快完成了...

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
There is an old saying, 'Everything comes to those who wait.' Oh, are you freezing? Why don't you rub your hands together?
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
俗話說“好事多磨”。哦，你冷嗎？不如搓搓手取暖吧？

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
It's complete! There you go. I think this one will look really good on you! Please take good care of this hat.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
完成了！給你。我覺得這頂帽子戴在你頭上一定很好看！請好好珍惜這頂帽子。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Hello there, young man.
What brings you to Lutie, town of goodwill and year round Christmas cheer?
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
你好，年輕人。
是什麼風把你吹到了充滿善意與全年聖誕歡愉的薑餅城？

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
I'm a master of creating stuffed animals, which make great presents. As we all know, everyone loves to hug cute and cuddly stuffed animals.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
我是製作毛絨玩具的大師，它們是很棒的禮物。眾所周知，每個人都喜歡擁抱可愛又柔軟的毛絨玩具。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
My specialty is the 'Teddybear Hat.' When it's worn, it makes you as cute as a teddy bear, and your hugs twice as warm and cuddly.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
我的拿手好戲是“小熊帽”。戴上它，你會變得像泰迪熊一樣可愛，你的擁抱也會變得兩倍溫暖、兩倍柔軟。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
The 'Teddybear Hat' can't be worn by just anyone, since it's cuddling powers are easily abused.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
“小熊帽”並非人人皆可佩戴，因為它的擁抱力量很容易被濫用。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
I sense that you are an adventurer with a good heart, and that a sweet girl like you deserves a nice gift.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
我感覺到你是一位心地善良的冒險者，像你這樣甜美的女孩值得擁有一份美好的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
But I sense that you are an adventurer with a pure heart and would not use the Teddybear Hat for selfish gain.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
但我感覺到你擁有一顆純淨的心，不會為了私利而濫用小熊帽。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
You can learn a lot about telling good people from the naughty after working for Santa for a loooong time...
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
在為聖誕老人工作這麼...這麼長的時間之後，我學會了如何分辨善良的人和淘氣的人...

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
You know more about such things after working for Santa for so long.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
在為聖誕老人工作這麼久之後，我對這些事情瞭解得更多。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Unfortunately, I don't have any material to make the headgear right now. But if you bring the materials, I will make you a 'Teddybear Hat' for free.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
不幸的是，我現在沒有製作頭飾的材料。但如果你帶來材料，我會免費為你製作一頂“小熊帽”。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Let's see...
I'll need...
^0000FF1 Panda Hat^000000,
^0000FF100 Needle Packet^000000,
^0000FF100 Spool^000000 and
^0000FF300 Black Bear Skin^000000.

[Fuzzy Fuzz]
So, do you think you can get all of them? I will be here waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[毛絨絨]
那麼，你覺得你能找到所有這些東西嗎？我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你身上攜帶的物品太多了。請先將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hmmm...
You look like you're having trouble carrying all of your things. Why don't you place some of your extra items into the Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
嗯...
看起來你搬運這些東西有些吃力。為什麼不多把一些多餘的東西放進卡普拉倉庫呢？

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hello, there.
Ah, I can tell that you already have a ^8C1717'Model Training Hat'^000000. I see that using it has corrected your posture.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
你好。
啊，我看得出你已經擁有了一頂^8C1717矯正姿勢之帽^000000。看來使用它已經矯正了你的姿勢。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Oh...
I forgot to tell you that I can not only put together a 'Model Training Hat,' I can disassemble it into its original parts.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
哦...
我忘了告訴你，我不僅能組裝“矯正姿勢之帽”，還能將其拆解回原始部件。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
If you give me ^0000FF1 'Model Training Hat'^000000 and ^0000FF1 'Arrow'^000000, I give you ^8C17171 'Apple of Archer'^000000 and ^8C17171 'Book'^000000. So, would you like to disassemble the items?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
如果你給我^0000FF1頂矯正姿勢之帽^000000和^0000FF1支箭^000000，我會給你^8C17171個蘋果頭飾^000000和^8C17171本書^000000。那麼，你想拆解這些物品嗎？

scripts.text: Disassemble
scripts.translation: 拆解

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Thank you.
It will not take that much time to make this hat, so please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
謝謝。
製作這頂帽子不會花太多時間，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
There you go.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
給你。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
If you want to make a
'Model Training Hat' again,
feel free to come back.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
如果你想再製作一頂“矯正姿勢之帽”，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I see.
I hope you will
continue to use that hat
to improve your posture
and glamorous poise.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了。
希望你能繼續使用那頂帽子來改善你的姿勢和優雅的風度。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
You brought the materials~
scripts.translation:
[南香]
你帶來了材料~

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Before I start to create the item, I'm obligated to warn you...
scripts.translation:
[南香]
在我開始製作物品之前，我有義務提醒你...

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
If the ^FF0000'Book' and 'Apple of Archer' items you have brought to make a 'Model Training Hat' was ^FF0000upgraded^000000, after I create the hat out of the book, ^FF0000these upgrades, including compounded cards, will be lost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[南香]
如果您用來製作^FF0000“矯正姿勢之帽”的“書本”和“蘋果頭飾”^FF0000是強化過的^000000，那麼在我用書本製作帽子後，^FF0000這些強化效果，包括鑲嵌的卡片，將會丟失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hanhyang]
So would you like to create the Model Training Hat right now?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
那麼，您現在想要製作矯正姿勢之帽嗎？

scripts.text: Create
scripts.translation: 製作

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Thank you.
Let me create one for you right away. Please have a seat and make yourself comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
謝謝。
我這就為您製作一頂。請坐，請隨意。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Usually we have a zeny service charge, but since you've got ^3355FFthe look^000000, I'll waive it.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
通常我們會收取Zeny服務費，但既然您擁有^3355FF那種氣質^000000，我就免除了。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Please wait a moment while I put this together.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
請稍等，讓我把它組裝起來。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
That wasn't too difficult. I hope you wear this hat everyday to improve your posture.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
這並不難。希望您能每天戴著這頂帽子，以改善您的姿勢。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
You may have trouble at first, keeping your balance and trying not to drop the apple. You may even feel incredible neck pain. But for the sake of beauty, it'll all be worth it.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
起初您可能會感到難以保持平衡，或者擔心蘋果掉下來。您甚至可能會感到頸部劇烈疼痛。但為了美麗，這一切都是值得的。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Here it is.
Oh, right, this arrow from the Apple of Archer is left over, so you can go ahead and take that.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
給您。
對了，這是製作蘋果頭飾時剩下的箭，您可以拿走了。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Also, I can disassemble the Model Training Hat into its original materials. So if you want the original items back, bring the Model Training Hat and the arrow I gave you.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
另外，我可以將矯正姿勢之帽分解回原始材料。如果您想要回原始物品，請帶上矯正姿勢之帽和我給您的那支箭。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I hope you
will have a
good day.
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
祝您度過美好的一天。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I see. You must have brought items with cards or upgrades that you didn't want to lose. Feel free to come back anytime when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了。您一定是帶了鑲嵌卡片或升級的物品，不想失去它們。當您準備好時，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hello~
Welcome to the Handsome Charm Modeling School. May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
你好~
歡迎來到帥哥魅力模特學校。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to be a model~!
scripts.translation: 我想成為模特~！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I see~
Although it's clear that you've got '^3355FFthe look^000000,' we can't accept any students at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了~
雖然很明顯您擁有“^3355FF那種氣質^000000”，但我們目前無法招收任何學生。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Lately, our director has been gone, and we aren't sure when he'll come back. ^333333*Sigh* I can't even remember the last time we got paid.^000000
scripts.translation:
[南香]
最近，我們的總監不在，我們不確定他什麼時候回來。^333333*嘆氣* 我甚至記不清上次發工資是什麼時候了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hmm... Wait a minute!
At the very least, we could train you to improve your posture so that you can walk with regal poise.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
嗯... 等等！
至少，我們可以訓練您改善姿勢，讓您能走出高貴優雅的步伐。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Although we can't offer any classes at this time, I can create a special 'Model Training Hat' for you. That way, you can practice the glamourous way of walking down the catwalk on your own.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
雖然我們現在無法提供課程，但我可以為您製作一頂特殊的“矯正姿勢之帽”。這樣，您就可以獨自練習在T臺上優雅走路的姿態了。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
But since our director is gone, we can't really use our budget to give you a hat. If you want, please bring me the following items...
scripts.translation:
[南香]
但由於我們的總監不在，我們無法動用預算為您提供帽子。如果您願意，請帶給我以下物品...

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Please bring...
^0000FF1 Apple of Archer^000000 and
^0000FF1 Book^000000.
Then I can fashion a 'Model Training Hat' for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
請帶來...
^0000FF1個蘋果頭飾^000000和^0000FF1本書^000000。
然後我就可以立刻為您製作一頂“矯正姿勢之帽”。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I understand.
Well, have a good day.
Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了。
那麼，祝您今天愉快。
謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Whoa, why are you carrying so many items with you?
You look so heavy...! Maybe you can walk more easily if you put some of your stuff away?
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
哇，你為什麼帶著這麼多東西？
看起來好重...！把一些東西收起來，走起路來可能會輕鬆一點哦？

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Hello, my name is Seth!
I like folding paper and making origami. I made my mommy a big paper boat, and she gave me a big smile and patted my head!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
你好，我叫賽斯！
我喜歡摺紙，做各種手工。我給媽媽折了一隻大紙船，她對我露出了大大的微笑，還摸了摸我的頭！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Today at school, I learned how to make a paper flower! The flower was sort of hard, but now I can do it! Then I made a tiny tiny flower and put in on my head~
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
今天在學校，我學會了摺紙花！紙花有點難，但我現在會了！然後我折了一朵小小的花，戴在了頭上~

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Hey~!
You have a Mr. Smile and Scarlet Dyestuffs! Yaaay~! I could use those and make you a paper flower. C'mon, lemme show you!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
嘿~！
你有笑臉面具和紅色染料！耶~！我可以用它們給你折一朵紙花。來吧，讓我給你看看！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Lemme make
one for you,
pwease pwease?
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
讓我給你折一個，求求你啦？

scripts.text: Alright!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text: No thanks kid.
scripts.translation: 不用了，小傢伙

scripts.text: Boys aren't supposed to make flowers.
scripts.translation: 男孩子不該折花

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Yay~
You're the best!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
耶~
你最棒了！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Let's see...
I cut Mr. Smile this way~.
*Snip Snip Snip~~*
*Snip...Snip...*
Yyyyyaaaeeep...
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
讓我看看...
我把笑臉面具這樣剪開~。
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓~~*
*咔嚓...咔嚓...*
耶...耶耶耶...

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Tah dah~!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
噹噹~！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Heheheh~!
I'm done!
I did a good job, didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
嘿嘿嘿~！
我做好了！
我做得很好，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Oh, here's the leftovers. Mommy says that we should always save things. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
哦，這是剩下的部分。媽媽說我們要總是節約東西。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Seth]
I'm a good boy!
I'm gonna make one for my little sister~! And everybody I love!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
我是個好男孩！
我要給妹妹也折一個~！還有我愛的人！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
If you want to see me make another one, just bring more Scarlet Dyestuffs and Mr.Smile, okay? Bye bye~!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
如果你想看我再折一個，就帶更多的紅色染料和笑臉面具來，好嗎？拜拜~！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
*Sniff sniff*
O-okay...
But I just wanted to show you how good I am...
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
*吸鼻子*
好...好吧...
但我只是想讓你看看我有多厲害...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Boys aren't supposed to make flowers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
男孩子不該折花。

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Waaaaaaah~!
But flowers are so nice and pweety!!!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
哇啊啊啊~！
但是花那麼漂亮啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
You want me to show you? Huh?
I can do it you want!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
你想讓我展示給你看？嗯？
只要你想要，我就可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Uh oh...
But I don't have anything to make paper flowers out of.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
哎呀...
但我沒有可以用來摺紙花的材料。

scripts.text: I'll get what you need.
scripts.translation: 我會去準備你需要的東西

scripts.text: Too bad!
scripts.translation: 真可惜！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Okay okay...
I neeeeed...
^3131FF1 Mr. Smile^000000 and
^3131FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000.
Then I can make you a tiiiiny little flower.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
好啦好啦...
我需...需要...
^3131FF1個笑臉面具^000000和^3131FF1個紅色染料^000000。
這樣我就能為你折一朵小小的花了。

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Seth will wait for you here. Promise me you'll come back?
scripts.translation:
[賽斯]
賽斯會在這裡等你的。答應我你會回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Wah~~~~~!

- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請在減輕負重後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Hey there. Um...
I'm the 'Mad Hatter.' Well, at least that's what I call myself.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
你好。那個...
我是“瘋帽匠”。至少我是這麼稱呼自己的。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
If you give me some stuff, I can renovate some of your old hats so that they really show your personality. Whether you're laid back or a party animal, I'll be able to make a hat just for you!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
如果你給我一些材料，我可以改造你的一些舊帽子，讓它們更能彰顯你的個性。無論你是隨性灑脫還是派對達人，我都能為你打造一頂專屬的帽子！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
You wanna take a look at the trendy, stylish hats I can make for you?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
你想看看我能為你打造的時尚潮流帽子嗎？

scripts.text: Party Hat
scripts.translation: 派對帽

scripts.text: Straw Hat
scripts.translation: 遮陽帽

scripts.text: Cowboy Hat
scripts.translation: 荒野之帽

scripts.text: Sombrero
scripts.translation: 寬邊帽

scripts.text: Beanie
scripts.translation: 毛線帽

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Party Hat! It's a Santa Hat I've remade by adding colorful paper for a festive look. Celebrate good times with a Party Hat! Come on!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
派對帽！這是我在聖誕帽的基礎上添加了彩色紙張，使其看起來更加喜慶的改造版。戴上派對帽，一起慶祝美好的時光吧！來吧！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哦等等！在我們開始之前，請確認一件事。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
If the Santa Hat you use to create this hat was upgraded or compounded with a card, all those upgrades will be lost. So, to be safe, I suggest you put everything in your inventory, other than the things to make the Party Hat, into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
如果你用來製作這頂帽子的聖誕帽經過強化或鑲嵌了卡片，所有的強化和卡片效果都會丟失。因此，為了安全起見，我建議你將除了製作派對帽所需材料以外的所有物品都存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It seems to me that you have everything. Alright! Shall I make you a Party Hat?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
看起來你什麼都準備好了。好的！要我為你製作一頂派對帽嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Umm, okay...
I guess being the life of the party is a bit too much for you, eh? Hmpf. Well, I know a good library in Juno where you can hang out...
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
嗯，好吧...
看來成為派對焦點對你來說有點太難了，是嗎？哼。不過我知道朱諾有個不錯的圖書館，你可以去那裡逛逛...

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Rustle Rustle Splat Splat*^000000
^3355FF*Squick Squick Grind Grind*^000000
^3355FF*Swish Swish Rustle Rustle*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*沙沙 沙沙 啪嗒 啪嗒*^000000
^3355FF*吱扭 吱扭 咯吱 咯吱*^000000
^3355FF*唰唰 沙沙 沙沙 沙沙*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It's done! Your new life, as the life of the party, has officially begun. All you need to do is wear this Party Hat. Though, knowing a couple jokes would probably help too.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
完成了！你作為派對焦點的新生活，正式開始了。你只需要戴上這頂派對帽。不過，要是能再學幾個笑話，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh by the way, there's some stuff left over. I guess you should hold onto it. You know, in case you need it later.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哦對了，還有一些剩下的材料。我想你應該留著它們。畢竟，以後說不定用得上呢。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh... man. Everyone needs a Party Hat! Even boring types get jazzed with pizazz wearing one of these!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哎呀...天哪。每個人都想要一頂派對帽！即使是那些無趣的傢伙，戴上它也會變得充滿活力和魅力！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
You can wear them for birthday parties, Christmas parties. Um, slumber parties. P-political parties.
......
And hunting parties?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
你可以戴著它去參加生日派對、聖誕派對。嗯，還有睡衣派對。政...政治集會。
......
以及狩獵小隊？

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Anyway, this is what I need to make a Party Hat...
1 ^3355FFSanta Hat^000000,
100 ^3355FFOil Paper^000000 and
100 ^3355FFSlick Paper^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
總之，製作一頂派對帽需要以下材料...
1個^3355FF聖誕帽^000000，100個^3355FF油紙^000000 和100個^3355FF光滑的紙^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I'll be right here when you decide to crank your life up a notch with a Party Hat.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
當你決定用一頂派對帽來提升生活格調時，我會一直在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Straw Hat! Made out of a Sakkat with bamboo and tough vines, it gives you a relaxed, rustic feeling when you wear it.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
遮陽帽！由草帽、竹筒和強韌木藤條製成，戴上它會讓你感到輕鬆愜意，充滿田園氣息。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Sakkat you use to create this hat was upgraded, any cards, slots or upgrades will disappear once I make a new hat out of it.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哦等等！在我們開始之前，請確認一件事。
如果你用來製作這頂帽子的草帽經過強化，那麼一旦我將其製成新帽子，所有的卡片、插槽和強化效果都會消失。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything else, other than the required hat items, into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
為了安全起見，我建議你將除了製作遮陽帽所需材料以外的所有物品都存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! I see you brought everything. Alright! Do you want me to make you a Straw Hat now?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
啊！看來你帶齊了所有材料。好的！要我現在就為你製作一頂遮陽帽嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Man...
I think you need this hat more than I thought. You have got to learn to just chill and relax~!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
天哪...
我覺得你比我想像的更需要這頂帽子。你一定要學會放鬆和享受悠閒的時光~！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Crunch Chew Chew Chew*^000000
^3355FF*Squish Squish Fwsht Fwsht*^000000
^3355FF*Crunch Crunch Tap Tap*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔嚓 咀嚼 咀嚼 咀嚼*^000000
^3355FF*噗嗤 噗嗤 嘶嘶 嘶嘶*^000000
^3355FF*咔嚓 咔嚓 噠噠 噠噠*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It's done!
Now you can wear this hat, feel cool, and relax with style.
Please come again~
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
完成了！
現在你可以戴上這頂帽子，感受涼爽，優雅地放鬆身心。
歡迎再次光臨~

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Straw Hat! It shades you from the heat of the sun and keeps farmers cool when they're working on the fields. It's a hat for cool, relaxed types and the hat of choice for some famous heroes!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
遮陽帽！它能為你遮擋烈日，讓農夫在田間勞作時保持涼爽。它是那些追求涼爽、悠閒風格的人的首選，也是許多著名英雄的選擇！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Anyways, I need all these to make you a Straw Hat...
1 ^3355FFSakkat^000000,
300 ^3355FFTough Vines^000000 and
300 ^3355FFPiece of Bamboo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
總之，為你製作一頂遮陽帽需要以下所有材料...
1個^3355FF草帽^000000，300個^3355FF強韌木藤條^000000 和300個^3355FF竹筒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I'll be right here when you decide that you want the perfect hat for laid back, kick back moods. Be cool~
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
當你決定想要一頂適合悠閒、放鬆心情的完美帽子時，我會一直在這裡等你。保持酷~

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I take a Western Grace, add some manliness, um, do some finangling, and Voila~! A Cowboy Hat!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
我拿一頂牛仔帽，加上一些陽剛之氣，嗯，稍作調整，Voila~！一頂荒野之帽！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It's a hat for adventure and exploration. Although it's a manly hat like no other, with a manly factor of 9, it also looks great on girls.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
這是一頂適合冒險和探索的帽子。雖然它有著無與倫比的陽剛之氣，陽剛指數高達9，但戴在女孩頭上也非常好看。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Western Grace you use to create this hat was upgraded, any cards or upgrades will be lost once I make a new hat out of it.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哦等等！在我們開始之前，請確認一件事。
如果你用來製作這頂帽子的牛仔帽經過強化，那麼一旦我將其製成新帽子，所有的卡片和強化效果都會丟失。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything, other than the required materials, into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
為了安全起見，我建議你將除必需材料以外的所有物品都存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! You brought everything already. Excellent. Do you want me to make a Cowboy Hat now?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
啊！你已經把所有材料都帶來了。真棒。你想讓我現在就為你製作一頂荒野之帽嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Well, I see.
I guess you just don't appreciate the value of cowboy heroes, do you?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
好吧，我明白了。
看來你並不欣賞西部英雄的價值，是嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Clik-clak Clik-clak Pam Pam Pam Pam*^000000
^3355FF*Bang Bang Ping Ping*^000000
^3355FF*Uk Uk Uk Uk Uhoh Uhoh*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔噠咔噠 咔噠咔噠 砰 砰 砰 砰*^000000
^3355FF*砰 砰 叮 叮*^000000
^3355FF*嗚 嗚 嗚 嗚 哎呀 哎呀*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Yeeeeehaw! With this hat on, you can tame broncos, rob stagecoaches, and look really stylish in duels!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
耶嘿！戴上這頂帽子，你可以馴服烈馬，搶劫馬車，還能在決鬥中看起來非常帥氣！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Cowboy Hat! This is a very popular that brings up images of frontier life and gunplay.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
荒野之帽！這是一種非常流行的帽子，讓人聯想到邊疆生活和槍戰。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Wearing a Cowboy Hat will make guys look tougher and more heroic, and will add untamed cuteness to the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
戴上荒野之帽，男士們會看起來更硬朗、更具英雄氣概，女士們則會增添幾分野性的可愛。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I need these items to make a Cowboy Hat...
1 ^3355FFWestern Grace^000000,
108 ^3355FFClaw of Desert Wolf^000000,
108 ^3355FFSoft Blade of Grass^000000 and
4 ^3355FFBurning Horseshoe^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
製作荒野之帽需要以下物品...
1個^3355FF牛仔帽^000000，108個^3355FF沙漠之狼之指甲^000000，108個^3355FF柔軟的草葉^000000 和4個^3355FF燃燒的馬蹄鐵^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
So when you decide to give your life a boost with rustic style, come back to me with those items so I can make you a Cowboy Hat.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
所以，當你決定用鄉村風格提升生活格調時，帶著這些物品回來找我，我會為你製作一頂荒野之帽。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah yes. Now here's a classy hat for mariachi heroes and Latin lovers. You can't deny the sex appeal that just pours from someone wearing a Sombrero.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
啊，是的。現在，這是一頂適合流浪樂隊英雄和拉丁情人的優雅帽子。戴著寬邊帽的人所散發出的魅力是無法否認的。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Straw Hat you use to creating this hat was upgraded, any cards or upgrades in this hat will be lost once I make the Sombrero.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哦等等！在我們開始之前，請確認一件事。
如果你用來製作這頂帽子的遮陽帽經過強化，那麼一旦我將其製成寬邊帽，所有的卡片和強化效果都會丟失。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything you don't need to make this hat into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
為了安全起見，我建議你將除製作這頂帽子所需的物品以外的所有東西都存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! You brought everything already. Alright! Do you want me to make you a Sombrero right away?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
啊！你已經把所有材料都帶來了。好的！你想讓我馬上為你製作一頂寬邊帽嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Fine, fine.
But think of all the sex appeal you're missing out on. Come on, you know you need a Sombrero.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
好吧，好吧。
但想想你錯過了多少魅力吧。拜託，你知道你需要一頂寬邊帽的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFZinga Zinga Zang Zang^000000
^3355FFDing Ding Ding Dan Dan Dan^000000
^3355FFAdios Amigo^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFZinga Zinga Zang Zang^000000
^3355FFDing Ding Ding Dan Dan Dan^000000
^3355FFAdios Amigo^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
With this Sombrero, you'll look like you have all kinds of style. Adios, cool guy~
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
戴上這頂寬邊帽，你會看起來非常有型。再見了，酷哥~

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Now, everyone needs a Sombrero. They're one of the most versatile hats in existence. You can wear them to formal events, you can wear them while napping, you can wear them just to hang out...
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
現在，每個人都需要一頂寬邊帽。它是現存最通用的帽子之一。你可以戴它參加正式場合，可以在小睡時戴它，也可以只是戴著它閒逛...

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Look, you don't need me to explain how cool a Sombrero is. It's just one of those things that everyone naturally knows. So I know you want one.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
看，我不需要解釋寬邊帽有多酷。這是大家天生就知道的事情。所以我知道你想要一頂。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
So this is what I need to make a Sombrero...
1 ^3355FFStraw Hat^000000,
50 ^3355FFCactus Needle^000000 and
1 ^3355FFGuitar^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
所以，製作寬邊帽需要以下物品...
1個^3355FF遮陽帽^000000，50個^3355FF仙人掌刺^000000 和1個^3355FF吉他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
That's all you need to have the coolest hat ever.
(Woohoo~!)
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
擁有這些，你就能擁有最酷的帽子了。
（萬歲~！）

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Beanie...!
Whaddup, broham. This hat keeps your head toasty, but let's you play things cool with your homeys. And, um, fly girls.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
針織帽...！
嘿，兄弟。這頂帽子能保暖，但也能讓你和哥們兒一起耍酷。還有，呃，吸引女孩。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Cap you use to make this Beanie was upgraded, any cards or upgrades will be lost once I make this hat!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
哦等等！在我們開始之前，請確認一件事。
如果你用來製作這頂針織帽的帽子經過強化，一旦我製作完成，所有的卡片和強化等級都將丟失！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything not needed to make this hat into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
為了安全起見，我建議你將製作這頂帽子不需要的物品存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! You brought everything already. Alright! How about I make you that Beanie right now?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
啊！你已經把所有東西都帶來了。很好！那我現在就為你製作那頂針織帽？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Okay...
Dork. Come back When you decide to join the cool guys, word?
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
好吧...
笨蛋。等你想加入酷哥行列的時候再來找我，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Crunch Chew Chew Chew*^000000
^3355FF*Squish Squish Fwsht Fwsht*^000000
^3355FF*Crunch Crunch Tap Tap*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔嚓 咀嚼 咀嚼 咀嚼*^000000
^3355FF*噗嗤 噗嗤 嘶嘶 嘶嘶*^000000
^3355FF*咔嚓 咔嚓 噠噠 噠噠*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
There you go! Your very own Beanie! Cute, but still 'dope!'
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
給你！這是屬於你的針織帽！很可愛，但依然很酷！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Uh! Uh!
I'm in da house!
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
嘿！嘿！
我在這呢！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Beanie!
Whether you plan to go to a house party, get your groove back, or be as fresh as a prince, you'll be chillin' with this fly style.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
針織帽！
無論你是打算去參加派對，找回節奏，還是像王子一樣帥氣，戴上這頂帽子你都會很酷。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
But well...
Although it can be a street fashion, Beanies also look really cute on some people.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
不過話說回來...
雖然針織帽可以是街頭時尚，但在某些人頭上看起來真的很可愛。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Anyway, this is what I need to make a Beanie...
1 ^3355FFCap^000000 and
500 ^3355FFYarn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
總之，製作針織帽需要以下物品...
1個^3355FF帽子^000000 和500個^3355FF毛線^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
When you decide to represent yo' hood, come to me with the stuff. I'll hook you up.
scripts.translation:
[瘋帽匠]
當你決定展示你的風格時，帶著材料來找我。我會幫你搞定。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你身上攜帶的物品太多了。請先將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The Monster Museum has prepared a special event for your support~!
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
魔物博物館為感謝您的支援，準備了特別活動~！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Accessories typically worn by monsters are now available for adventurers to wear!
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
通常由魔物佩戴的飾品，現在也可以供冒險者佩戴了！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Of course, since we're on a trial period, we can only provide 3 monster accessories to our fans. However, according to your response, we may add more monster accessories in the future.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
當然，由於目前處於試用階段，我們只能向粉絲提供3件魔物飾品。不過，根據您的反饋，我們未來可能會增加更多魔物飾品。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Simply bring the required materials, and pay a small fee, and we will provide you with the monsters accessory of your choice.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
只需攜帶所需材料，並支付少量費用，我們就會為您提供您選擇的魔物飾品。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Please choose the
accessory you are
interested in.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
請選擇您感興趣的飾品。

scripts.text: Decorative Golden Bell
scripts.translation: 巨大的金鈴鐺

scripts.text: Crown of Ancient Queen
scripts.translation: 古代女王的王冠

scripts.text: Crown of Mistress
scripts.translation: 蜂后的王冠

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
This Golden Bell is fashioned after the one worn by the 'Sohee' monster. It's a cute accessory I personally recommend for us ladies. A little oversized, but I believe you'll like it a lot.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
這個金鈴鐺是仿照“鬼女”魔物佩戴的鈴鐺製作的。這是一款可愛的飾品，我個人非常推薦給女士們。雖然有點大，但我相信您會很喜歡它的。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Thank you for
bringing everything.
Please wait one moment.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
感謝您帶來了所有材料。
請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Clang Clang! Scrape Scrape! Jingle Jingle! *^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF* 叮噹叮噹！沙沙沙沙！叮鈴叮鈴！ *^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Yoohoo~
There you go. Here's your beautiful Golden Bell. I doubt it will jingle if you shake your head, though.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
喲吼~
好了。這是您漂亮的金鈴鐺。不過我懷疑，即使您搖頭，它也不會發出聲音哦。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Oh, one more thing, don't confuse yourself with Sohee and commit suicide!
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
哦，還有一件事，別把自己和鬼女搞混了，然後去尋短見！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
If you'd like me to make another one, please come again. Thank you for visiting the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
如果您想再做一個，請隨時再來。感謝您光臨魔物博物館。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The required materials for the Decorative Golden Bell are...
^3355FF1 Golden Bell, 1 Emperium, 3 Gold^000000 and
20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
製作巨大的金鈴鐺所需的材料是...
^3355FF1個寵物鈴鐺，1個華麗金屬，3個金塊^000000以及20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Just come ask me
when you're ready.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
準備好了隨時來找我。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
This crown is inspired by the one worn by the 'Isis' monster. It has an elegant look fitting for ancient royalty.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
這頂王冠是仿照“蛇女伊絲”魔物佩戴的王冠製作的。它擁有符合古代王室身份的優雅外觀。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Thank you for
bringing everything.
Please wait one moment.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
感謝您帶來了所有材料。
請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Clang Clang! Scrape Scrape! Jingle Jingle! *^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF* 叮噹叮噹！沙沙沙沙！叮鈴叮鈴！ *^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Tah dah!
Here's your Crown of Ancient Queen! I don't know if you can get anyone to bow before you while wearing this, but at least you'll look elegant.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
噹噹！
這是您的古代女王的王冠！我不知道戴著它能否讓所有人向您鞠躬，但至少您會看起來非常優雅。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
If you'd like me to make another one, please come again. Thank you for visiting the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
如果您想再做一個，請隨時再來。感謝您光臨魔物博物館。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The required materials for the Crown of Ancient Queen are...
^3355FF1 Queen's Hair Ornament, 1 Emperium, 3 Gold^000000 and
20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
製作古代女王的王冠所需的材料是...
^3355FF1個蛇飾髮箍，1個華麗金屬，3個金塊^000000以及20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Just come ask me
when you're ready.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
準備好了隨時來找我。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
This crown is an imitation of the one worn by the 'Mistress' monster. Wearing this will give you a look of brusque authority.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
這頂王冠是仿照“蜂后”魔物佩戴的王冠製作的。戴上它，您將展現出威嚴的氣場。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Thank you for
bringing everything.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
感謝您帶來了所有材料。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
^FF0000By the way, if you use an upgraded
Coronet for making this item,
the item you create out of the Coronet
will not have its upgraded status.^000000
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
^FF0000順便說一下，如果您使用升級過的蛇飾髮箍來製作此物品，由蛇飾髮箍製作出的物品將不會保留升級狀態。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
^FF0000Also, please only have one Coronet in your inventory to make the Crown of Mistress. We are not responsible for any loss.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
^FF0000另外，製作蜂后的王冠時，請確保您的物品欄中只有一件王冠。我們不對任何丟失負責。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Are you sure you want to create the Crown of Mistress?
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
您確定要製作蜂后的王冠嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Wait a minute...!
scripts.translation: 等一下...

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Please wait one moment.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Clang Clang! Scrape Scrape! Jingle Jingle! *^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF* 叮噹叮噹！沙沙沙沙！叮鈴叮鈴！ *^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Yay! You've got a great looking crown!
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
耶！您有一頂非常漂亮的王冠！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
I don't know if everyone will obey your commands while wearing this, but at least you can feel beautifully regal.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
我不知道戴著它時大家是否都會聽從您的命令，但至少您可以感受到那種美麗的威嚴。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Why don't you go take a picture with Mistress? That would be funny to see if she wasn't too busy trying to maul you.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
您不妨去和蜂后合個影？如果她沒忙著試圖咬您的話，那畫面一定很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
If you'd like me to make you another one, please come again. Thank you for visiting the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
如果您想讓我再為您製作一頂，歡迎隨時再來。感謝您光臨魔物博物館。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
No problem, just be sure to understand our precautions well, okay?
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
沒問題，不過請務必理解我們的注意事項，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The required materials for the Crown of Mistress are...
^3355FF1 Coronet, 1 Emperium, 3 Gold^000000 and
40,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
製作蜂后的王冠所需的材料是...
^3355FF1個王冠、1個華麗金屬、3個金塊^000000以及40,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Just come ask me
when you're ready.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[內里斯]
準備好了隨時來找我。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Hmmm...
It's seems you're carrying too much stuff for me to give anything to you.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
嗯...
看來你攜帶的物品太多了，我沒法把東西給你。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Talk to me again after you've freed up some of your inventory space by putting some of your things into the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
請先去卡普拉倉庫存放一些物品，騰出物品欄空間後再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Oooh yeah!
Sometimes, even I can't believe how much this body of mine ripples with sexy love muscles~! I can barely hold them all in...
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
噢噢！
有時候連我自己都難以置信，我身上這充滿性感魅力的肌肉是如何起伏的~！我簡直快要控制不住它們了...

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
It's...
It's sexy time!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
這是...
性感時刻！

scripts.text: Give him items
scripts.translation: 給他物品

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Ooh... Finally!
You brought them!
Excellent, excellent!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
噢...終於！
你帶來了！
太棒了，太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Alright...
Now I can use this Mr.Scream and all these clock hands to continue my testing.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
好了...
現在我可以利用這個整人面具和所有的指標繼續我的測試了。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
And, this is yours. All yours.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
還有，這個是你的。完全屬於你。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Well then... Farewell!
Don't forget to bring me more Mr.Screams and clock hands if you find more of them!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
那麼...再見！
如果你找到更多的整人面具和指標，別忘了帶給我！

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Hmmm...?
That's funny, I thought you would have that Mr. Scream mask and all those clock hands by now...
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
嗯...？
真奇怪，我以為你現在應該已經拿到那個整人面具和那些指標了...

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
But...
Not everyone is fortunate to have a magnificent, flawless physique. There are people in this world that have tragically lost appendages in accidents.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
但是...
並非每個人都有幸擁有完美無瑕的健美身材。世界上有些人因為在事故中不幸失去了肢體，處境十分悲慘。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
When I realized this, I decided to help these people and began to research technology for artificial limbs. My studies have lead me to Alarms and their own mechanical limbs known as 'Ruimento.'
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
當我意識到這一點後，我決定幫助這些人，並開始研究假肢技術。我的研究讓我關注到了鍾怪以及它們擁有的被稱為“Ruimento”的機械肢體。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
The Alarms, and their 'Ruimento,' are made from an ancient mysterious technology. You can only find these in the Clock Tower.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
鍾怪及其“Ruimento”是由一種古老的神秘技術製造的。你只能在鐘樓找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
So I am trying to research a method to reproduce Ruimetto, except in a smaller form for the human body. If I'm successful, it would be a medical miracle!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
所以我正在研究一種方法來復制Ruimento，只是將其縮小以適應人體。如果成功，那將是一個醫學奇蹟！

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
However, I need help in completing my research. Hence, the reason I've told you my story, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
然而，我需要幫助來完成我的研究。這就是我向你講述我故事的原因，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
I desperately need materials to continuing testing so that I can develop a prototype. I'll need ^0000FFClock Hand^000000 from Alarms and ^0000FFMr. Scream^000000 in order to continue my research.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
我急需材料來繼續測試，以便開發原型。我需要來自鍾怪的^0000FF指標^000000和^0000FF整人面具^000000才能繼續我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
I would collect these things myself but everytime I go up to the Clock Tower, I can't bear to break the Alarms, and just stare in awe at their mechanical, masculine physiques.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
我本來可以自己去收集這些東西，但每次我登上鐘樓，我都無法忍心破壞鍾怪，只是驚歎於它們那機械而陽剛的身材。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
So...
If you help me out, I promise to give you, um...
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
那麼...
如果你能幫我的忙，我保證會給你，呃...

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
...this Alarm Mask!
.....
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
...這個鍾怪假面！
.....

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
I'd wear it myself, if it weren't for the fact that people never look at my face anyway. Everyone I meet seems to be fixated on my chiseled form. But trust me, this mask is pretty cool.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
如果不是因為人們從來不看我的臉，我肯定會自己戴上的。我遇到的每個人似乎都只盯著我雕刻般的身材。但相信我，這個面具真的很酷。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Please adventurer...
Help me give muscles to the world.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
拜託了，冒險者...
幫我向全世界傳播肌肉的力量吧。

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Oh~~! You know how I feel about Alarm's beautiful mechanic muscle! I am glad to have met someone who shares my good sense of taste.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
哦~~！你也懂得欣賞鍾怪那美麗的機械肌肉！很高興能遇到和我品味相投的人。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Okay, here's the deal.
Bring me...
^0000FF3000 Clock Hand^000000 and
^0000FF1 Mr. Scream^000000.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
好了，交易是這樣的。
給我...
^0000FF3000個指標^000000 和^0000FF1個整人面具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
With those, I will be able to continue my research, at least for a while. As I told you, I will give you this awesome ^0000FFAlarm Mask^000000 for those items!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
有了這些，我就能繼續我的研究了，至少能維持一段時間。正如我所說的，我會用這些物品交換給你這個超棒的^0000FF鍾怪假面^000000！

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Now! Go for it!
Let's spread our love for muscle around the globe!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
現在！去吧！
讓我們把對肌肉的熱愛傳遍全球！

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Oh~! I'm sorry!!
I guess I must have pumped one of these glorious biceps on accident.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
哦~！對不起！！
我想我是不小心秀了一下這光榮的二頭肌。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
I forget how breathtaking the sheer majesty of my body can be. It's alright, take your time, savor the visual pleasure...
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
我忘了我身體的宏偉壯觀是多麼令人驚歎。沒關係，慢慢欣賞，享受這視覺盛宴...

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
But listen, I'll need:
^0000FF3000 Clock Hand^000000 and
^0000FF1 Mr. Scream^000000
in order to continue my research.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
但是聽好了，我需要：
^0000FF3000個指標^000000 和^0000FF1個整人面具^000000才能繼續我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
As I told you, I will give you this really nifty ^0000FFAlarm Mask^000000 for those items, as well as do any sort of pose for you.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
正如我所說的，我會用這些物品交換給你這個非常酷的^0000FF鍾怪假面^000000，並且還會為你擺出各種姿勢。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Now! Go for it!
Let's spread our love for muscle around the globe!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
現在！去吧！
讓我們把對肌肉的熱愛傳遍全球！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're over weight -
- to receive more items from this NPC. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你目前的負重過高，無法從該NPC處接收更多物品。請將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Hm...?
What's that
you have on you?
Ah, a Claw of Desert Wolf~!
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
嗯...？
你身上帶著什麼？
啊，是沙漠之狼之指甲~！

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
You can only get one of those if you've been traveling for a long time in the desert. I guess someone like you also appreciates the beauty of my homeland.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
只有在沙漠裡旅行很久的人才能拿到這個。看來像你這樣的人也欣賞我家鄉的美麗。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Ahahaha~
If you've spent enough time in the Morocc desert, I'm sure you also appreciate the value of a high quality hat to beat the heat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
啊哈哈~
如果你在夢羅克沙漠待得夠久，我相信你也會懂得一頂高質量帽子在抵禦炎熱時的價值。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Tell you what. I've learned a lot studying about animals, so if you give me the right materials, I'll make you a ^3355FFtruly great hat^000000.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
這樣吧。我研究動物學到了很多，所以如果你給我合適的材料，我會為你製作一頂^3355FF真正出色的帽子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Just remember...
If you give me any equipment compounded with cards or with upgrades, ^ff0000any upgraded abilities and cards in those items will be lost after I make something out of them.^000000 So, please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
請記住...
如果你給我鑲嵌了卡片或升級過的裝備，^ff0000那些物品中的升級屬性和卡片在我製作東西后會丟失。^000000所以，請留意這一點。

scripts.text: Drooping Cat
scripts.translation: 懶洋洋的貓

scripts.text: Smokie Leaf
scripts.translation: 變身樹葉

scripts.text: Lazy Smokie
scripts.translation: 討厭的狸貓

scripts.text: Blue Fish
scripts.translation: 藍色魚

scripts.text: That's... okay.
scripts.translation: 那...好吧

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Ah...
You brought everything.
Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Drooping Cat.'
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
啊...
你把所有東西都帶來了。
太好了！請給我一點時間，讓我製作“懶洋洋的貓”。

scripts.text: *Scratch scratch...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*
*Scratch scratch...*

^3355FFHmm...
Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
哦，別擔心。快完成了。

scripts.text: *Swish swish...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*
*Chikachikachoom*
scripts.translation:
*沙沙聲...*
*咀嚼聲...*
*咔嚓咔嚓*

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
There you go. *Phew~*
Your own 'Drooping Cat' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
好了。*呼~*
這是你的“懶洋洋的貓”帽子，基於科學原理製作！另外，介意我留下那根沙漠之狼指甲嗎？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Why don't I make you...
a 'Drooping Cat?'
Having a cat for a hat makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out...
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我為什麼不給你做一頂...
“懶洋洋的貓”呢？
只要聽我解釋，你就會明白用貓做帽子是有某種道理的...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
At the Juno Library, I read in this issue of 'Funtime Kid Science' that all cats, whether they're wild or domesticated, are hunters that have mastered the art of saving their energy.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
在朱諾圖書館，我在《兒童趣味科學》的一期雜誌上讀到，所有的貓，無論是野生的還是家養的，都是精通節省能量藝術的獵人。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
After investing many hours napping in the sun, they've developed the perfect position to nap in any place and in any condition: the lazy feline droop.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
在享受了數小時的陽光小睡之後，它們發展出了在任何地方、任何條件下都能完美小睡的姿勢：慵懶的貓式垂頭。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
It's impossible for humans to even imitate this special feline skill without the inspiration from this hat!
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
如果沒有這頂帽子的靈感，人類甚至無法模仿這種特殊的貓科技能！

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And even if you don't manage to copy the napping cat droop, at least this'll keep the sun off the top of your head, if not out of your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
即使你沒能複製出那種慵懶的貓式垂頭，至少這頂帽子能擋住頭頂的陽光，即使不能完全遮住眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
The items I need are...
1 ^ff0000slotted Circlet^000000,
1 ^ff0000Black Dyestuffs^000000
and 300 ^ff0000Black Cat Doll^000000.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我需要的材料是...
1個^ff0000帶插槽的頭冠^000000，1個^ff0000黑色染料^000000和300個^ff0000黑貓娃娃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I will make a Drooping Cat right away when you bring all of those items.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
當你把所有材料都帶來後，我會立刻為你製作“懶洋洋的貓”。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Ah...
You brought everything.
Excellent! Okay, give me some time to put this 'Smokie Leaf' together.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
啊...
你把所有東西都帶來了。
太好了！請給我一點時間，我來組裝這個“變身樹葉”。

scripts.text: *Scratch scratch...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*
*Scratch scratch...*

^3355FFHmm...
Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
哦，別擔心。快完成了。

scripts.text: *Swish swish...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*
*P-peeeeeeeeep*

[Lee Hester]
There you go. *Phew~*
Your own 'Smokie Leaf' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
好了。*呼~*
這是你的專屬“變身樹葉”帽子，由科學原理驅動！另外，介意我收下那根沙漠之狼指甲嗎？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
How about...
a 'Smokie Leaf?'
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
怎麼樣...
想要一個“變身樹葉”嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I know, I know, wearing a big ol' Leaf on top of your head sounds impractical. But, it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我知道，我知道，在頭上戴一片大葉子聽起來很不實用。但如果你聽我解釋一下，這其實是有某種道理的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Do you ever notice how on a hot day, you feel a lot cooler when you wear white, but you're a lot warmer when you wear black?
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
你有沒有注意到，在炎熱的日子裡，穿白色衣服會覺得涼快很多，而穿黑色衣服則會覺得熱很多？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
After some intense thinking, and reading some 'Funtime Kid Science' magazines in Juno, I realized that the color black absorbs sunlight and heat, and that the color white reflects it.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
經過一番深思熟慮，並在朱諾閱讀了一些《趣味兒童科學》雜誌後，我意識到黑色會吸收陽光和熱量，而白色則會反射它們。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So...
What happens if you're wearing no colors? If my ^333333*ahem*^000000 hypothesis is correct, you wouldn't feel any heat if you were invisible!
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
那麼...
如果你不穿任何顏色呢？如果我的^333333*咳咳*^000000假設是正確的，當你隱形時，你就不會感覺到任何熱量！

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
That's why I've created this Racoon Leaf, in an attempt to imitate Smokie's uncanny invisibility powers.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
這就是我製作這片“變身葉子”的原因，試圖模仿狸貓那不可思議的隱形能力。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
It...
I haven't gotten it to work the way I want to yet. But it's a big leaf! It'll offer some shade.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
它...
我還沒能讓它完全按我想要的樣子工作。但它是一片大葉子！它能提供一些陰涼。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
All I need to make this is...
600 ^ff0000Raccoon Leaf^000000.
It's weird, but I need a whole lot of little leaves to make a big one.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
製作這個我只需要...
600個^ff0000變身葉子^000000。
這很奇怪，但我需要很多小葉子才能做成一片大葉子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Ah....
You brought everything.
Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Lazy Smokie' hat.
....
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
啊....
你把所有東西都帶來了。
太好了！請給我一點時間，我來製作“討厭的狸貓”帽子。
....

scripts.text: *Scratch scratch...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*
*Scratch scratch...*

^3355FFHmm...
Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
哦，別擔心。快完成了。

scripts.text: *Swish swish...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*
*Glunk.*
scripts.translation:
*沙沙沙...*
*咔嚓咔嚓...*
*咕嘰。*

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
There you go. *Phew~*
Your own 'Lazy Smokie' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
好了。*呼~*
這是你的專屬“討厭的狸貓”帽子，由科學原理驅動！另外，介意我收下那根沙漠之狼指甲嗎？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Why don't I make...
a 'Lazy Smokie?'
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
為什麼我不做...
一個“討厭的狸貓”呢？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I know, I know, having a Racoon on your head sounds ridiculous, but it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我知道，我知道，頭上頂著一隻狸貓聽起來很荒謬，但如果你聽我解釋一下，這其實是有某種道理的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So I learned from an issue of 'Funtime Kid Science' at Juno Library that different colors absorb or reflect sunlight.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
所以我在朱諾圖書館的一本《趣味兒童科學》雜誌上了解到，不同的顏色會吸收或反射陽光。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Wearing one color makes you feel warmer, and another makes you feel cooler on a hot day.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
在炎熱的日子裡，穿一種顏色會讓你感覺更熱，而另一種顏色會讓你感覺更涼快。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So I was thinking...
What if I had no colors?
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
所以我在想...
如果我沒有任何顏色呢？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And, as we all know, you wear no colors if you're invisible, or when you're completely nude. I've already conducted my nudity experiment with sad and pitiable results...
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
而且，眾所周知，如果你隱形了，或者完全裸體，你就沒有任何顏色。我已經做過裸體實驗，結果令人悲傷且可憐...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So now I'm experimenting with invisibility. I've tried using a human sized Smokie Leaf to become invisible, but it didn't really work yet. So I got to thinking...
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
所以我現在正在研究隱形。我試過用一張人類尺寸的變身樹葉來讓自己隱形，但效果並不理想。於是我開始思考...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
If I somehow connected a Smokie to me, would I become invisible when he becomes invisible?
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
如果我把一隻狸貓和我連線起來，當它隱形時，我是不是也會隱形？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I haven't been able to try it yet, because Smokies are pretty heavy and I've got to build up my neck muscles before I can strap a Smokie to my head.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我還沒法嘗試，因為狸貓挺重的，我得先鍛鍊頸部肌肉，才能把狸貓綁在頭上。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So of course I need a practice Smokie to wear on my head before I'm ready for the real thing.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
所以，在準備好真正的狸貓之前，我當然需要一隻練習用的狸貓戴在頭上。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And that was how I invented the 'Lazy Smokie' hat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
就這樣，我發明了“討厭的狸貓”帽子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
The items I need are...
1000 ^ff0000Acorn^000000,
100 ^ff0000Sea-Otter Fur^000000 and
10 ^ff0000Raccoon Leaf^000000.

[Lee Hester]
Ah...
You brought everything.
Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Blue Fish' hat out of all this fish.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
啊...
你全都帶來了。
太好了！請給我一點時間，用這些魚製作“藍色魚”帽子。

scripts.text: *Scratch scratch...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*
*Scratch scratch...*

^3355FFHmm...
Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
哦，別擔心。快完成了。

scripts.text: *Swish swish...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*
*Wataaaaa~!*

[Lee Hester]
There you go. *Phew~*
Your own 'Blue Fish' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
好了。*呼~*
這是屬於你的“藍色魚”帽子，基於科學原理製作！另外，介意我留下那根沙漠之狼指甲嗎？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Ah! I got it!
How about I make you...
a 'Blue Fish' hat?
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
啊！我想到了！
不如我為你製作...
一頂“藍色魚”帽子？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I know putting a Fish on top of your head doesn't sound like the best idea, but it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我知道，頭上頂著一隻魚聽起來不是個好主意，但如果你聽我解釋一下，這其實是有某種道理的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So I was reading some issues of 'Funtime Kid Science' at the Juno Library, and read about animals that take naps under the sun when they feel really hot.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
所以我在朱諾圖書館讀了幾期《趣味兒童科學》雜誌，瞭解到有些動物在感覺特別熱的時候會在陽光下打盹。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
 So then I thought...
Animals that don't take naps under the sun must never feel hot?
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
於是我想...
那些不在陽光下打盹的動物，一定從不覺得熱吧？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I decided to make a hat of that one perfect beast that was immune to the sun, never having to succumb its power.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我決定用那隻完美免疫陽光、從未屈服於其力量的神獸來做一頂帽子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I set to work immediately, listing all the animals I know that don't take naps in the sun. Then, I removed any animals from the list that I didn't like, especially the ones with really long names.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我立刻開始工作，列出了所有我知道的不在陽光下打盹的動物。然後，我把我不喜歡的動物從列表中刪掉了，尤其是那些名字特別長的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Finally, I had only three creatures on my list: the Emu, the Giraffe and the Fish.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
最後，我的列表上只剩下三種生物：鴯鶓、長頸鹿和魚。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
First, I removed Emu, because everyone kept telling me I was spelling it wrong. And as everyone knows, a Giraffe hat would just look ridiculous. So, of course, I chose the Fish.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
首先，我刪掉了鴯鶓，因為大家一直說我拼寫錯了。而且眾所周知，長頸鹿帽子看起來會很荒謬。所以，我當然選擇了魚。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And that, my friend, was how I invented the 'Blue Fish' hat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
就這樣，我的朋友，我發明了“藍色魚”帽子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
The items I need are...
^ff00001 Rotten Fish,
300 Stinky Scale,
50 Sushi,
1 Fish Tail^000000 and
^ff0000100 Sticky Mucus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我需要的材料是...
^ff00001個腐臭之魚、300個腐爛鱗片、50個明蝦壽司、1個魚尾^000000和^ff0000100個粘稠液體^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh... I see.
I'm a little disappointed, but you probably already have a nice hat to keep the sun out of your eyes. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
哦...我明白了。
我有點失望，但你大概已經有一頂不錯的帽子來遮擋陽光了。好吧，如果你改變主意，我會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Isn't it such
a beautiful day
today?
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
今天天氣真美啊，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Beautiful...
But insanely hot.
I live here, I should know. Still, nothing can beat the Morocc sunset.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
很美...
但熱得讓人發瘋。
