我住在這裡，我當然知道。不過，沒有什麼能比得上夢羅克的日落。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
It's amazing how so many different animals can live in the desert. I've been spending some time researching the ways of animals, reading books in the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
真令人驚歎，沙漠裡竟然能生存這麼多不同的動物。我花了一些時間研究動物的習性，在朱諾圖書館裡讀了不少書...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Trying to figure out the Animal Kingdom's secrets of dealing with the heat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
試圖弄清楚動物王國應對高溫的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I hope you're having a good time here in Morocc. If you ever question the special abilities of animals, just think of the majestic Desert Wolf that's able to thrive in the harsh Morocc deserts.
scripts.translation:
[李·海絲特]
我希望你在夢羅克玩得開心。如果你懷疑動物的特殊能力，想想那隻在嚴酷的夢羅克沙漠中繁衍生息的雄偉沙漠之狼吧。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Yelp! Yelp yelp!
Yelp! Yelp yelp!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
嗷！嗷嗷！
嗷！嗷嗷！

scripts.text: Shake head
scripts.translation: 搖頭

scripts.text: Nod head
scripts.translation: 點頭

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Yelp! Yelp yelp!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
嗷！嗷嗷！

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！ -
- 您目前攜帶的物品太多了。請將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫後再回來。 -

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Oh! You finally brought what I've asked, human. Okay, now I can bring her back to life!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
哦！你終於帶來了我要的東西，人類。好了，現在我可以讓她復活了！

scripts.text: Give items
scripts.translation: 交出物品

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Now...
Take this
and get out
of my sight~!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
現在...
拿著這個然後從我的視線裡消失~！

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
......Errr?
Now why am I in human form again?
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
......呃？
為什麼我又變回人形了？

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I guess... I need to practice transformation more often. *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我想...我需要更經常練習變身。*嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Anyway, I've got a bone to pick with you humans. You're an aggressive and greedy race, always killing things and taking stuff. And despite all the hunting, you never seem to be satisfied.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
總之，我有一筆賬要和你們人類算。你們是個好鬥且貪婪的種族，總是殺戮並奪取東西。儘管獵殺了這麼多，你們似乎永遠都不滿足。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
You always intrude our territory to slay us foxes for our nice, soft fur. But it's not only us you harass. The Sohees always complain that you barbaric humans keep stealing their clothing!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
你們總是侵入我們的領地，獵殺我們狐狸以獲取我們柔軟漂亮的皮毛。但你們騷擾的不僅僅是我們。鬼女們總是抱怨你們這些野蠻的人類不斷偷竊她們的衣服！

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
My wife was killed as a victim of human greed, probably skinned for her fabulous pelt...
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我的妻子成為了人類貪婪的受害者，大概是因為她那華麗的皮毛而被剝皮...

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
All I want is to bring her back to life, no matter what the cost. That's why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you for help.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我只想讓她復活，不惜一切代價。這就是我放下尊嚴，向你求助的原因。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I need...
^0000FF999^000000 ^FF0000Nine Tail^000000
in order to cast the Fox Resurrection spell.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我需要...
^0000FF999^000000個^FF0000九尾狐^000000才能施展狐族復活術。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I know how you humans think...
You want some sort of reward for whatever mayhem you cause. Alright then...
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我知道你們人類是怎麼想的...
你們總是想為造成的破壞索取某種報酬。好吧...

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I will give you this ^0000FFKitsune Mask^000000 if you bring me what I asked. How does that sound? Remember, ^0000FF999 ^FF0000Nine Tail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
如果你能給我我想要的東西，我就把這個^0000FF狐狸假面^000000給你。怎麼樣？記住，^0000FF999個^FF0000九尾狐^000000。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請在減輕負重後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
.......
.........
Human, what are you doing in my home?!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
......
........
人類，你在我家裡幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hurrumph.
I guess you decided to come inside, thinking no one was around, to rest after killing others of my kind.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哼。
看來你殺了我這麼多同類之後，以為屋裡沒人，就進來休息了。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Well! We Orcs are a proud race!
So don't expect me to talk to you.
Though, I must admit that you have courage to enter an Orc's home.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
聽著！我們獸人是驕傲的種族！
所以別指望我會跟你說話。
不過，我不得不承認，你有勇氣進入獸人的家。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I'm too tired to kill you today, but keep silent! If you're wounded, you can bleed quietly on the floor and die with some honor I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我今天太累了，不想殺你，但給我閉嘴！如果你受了傷，就安靜地在地板上流血，帶著一點尊嚴死去吧。

scripts.text: Come on, let's talk.
scripts.translation: 來吧，我們談談

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You dare invite an Orc to conversation?! We Orcs are a savage race! Born out suffering, we only live to fight and do battle!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你竟敢邀請一個獸人交談？！我們獸人是野蠻的種族！在苦難中出生，我們只為戰鬥和廝殺而活！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Talk with humans?!
Hah! The only way I will suffer such humiliation would be if you too, lost your dignity.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
跟人類說話？！
哈！唯一讓我忍受這種屈辱的方式，就是你也失去了你的尊嚴。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You can bleed in my house, but I will only talk with you if...
You bring ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你可以在我的房子裡流血，但我只會在...你帶來^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000的情況下才跟你說話！

scripts.text: I challenge you to a duel, Orc!
scripts.translation: 我向你發起決鬥，獸人！

scripts.text: 1000 Jellopies it is.
scripts.translation: 那就1000個傑勒比結晶

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Humans... such annoying bastards!
If you want to fight, go outside!
So get out of my house!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
人類...真是一群討厭的傢伙！
如果你想打架，就出去！
所以滾出我的房子！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hah! It's a promise then!
Bwahahahahhahahahahahaha!
That's 1000 Jellopies!
Are all you humans so foolish?!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哈！那就說定了！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
那是1000個傑勒比結晶！
你們人類都這麼愚蠢嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
WHAT?!
That's so much Jellopy!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
什麼？！
那可是好多傑勒比結晶啊！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I do not like this joke you have played on me human. Still, I refuse to believe that you have really brought ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我不喜歡你對我開的這個玩笑，人類。不過，我拒絕相信你真的帶來了^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs are a proud race and do not like to admit when we are wrong.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我們獸人是驕傲的種族，不喜歡承認自己錯了。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
One...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
一...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
One... T-two...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
一...二...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
One... T-two...
Three...

[Orc Warrior]
One... T-two...
Three...
....F-f-fooooour...

[Orc Warrior]
.......

[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
九百九十八...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
九百九十八...
九百九十九...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
One...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
九百九十八...
九百九十九...
一...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
One... One thousand.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
九百九十八...
九百九十九...
一...一千。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Curse you, human.
You have shall your 'conversation.'
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
該死的人類。
你想要的“對話”，我給你。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I hate humans! In fact, all Orcs hate humans! Hate you hate you hate you with a passion!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我討厭人類！事實上，所有獸人都討厭人類！我恨你，恨你，恨你入骨！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
So...
Still in the mood to talk?!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那麼...
你還想繼續聊嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Tough!
If you want to
hear more, bring...
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
想得美！
如果你想聽更多，就帶來...
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now get out of here, you horrible stinking, poor excuse for an animal!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在滾出這裡，你這臭烘烘、低劣的畜生！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?!
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你忘了嗎？！
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想對話，就拿出你的誠意。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
No.... Not again!!
What are you doing with so much Jellopy?!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
不...不要再來了！！
你帶這麼多傑勒比結晶幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Damn...!
I refuse to speak to you until I've finished counting all of this Jellopy.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
該死...
在我數完這些傑勒比結晶之前，我拒絕和你說話。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
.....

[Orc Warrior]
...
.....
ONE THOUSAND.

[Orc Warrior]
Once again, human, you've managed to infuriate me. But we Orcs are a proud race. I shall fulfill my part of this pathetic deal.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
人類，你又一次成功激怒了我。但我們獸人是驕傲的種族。我會履行這份可笑協議中的義務。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, where was I?
Oh right.
How much I hate humans.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，我剛才說到哪了？
哦，對了。
我有多討厭人類。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Humans are always invading our village, intruding on our land! They kill our warriors not out of honor, but for selfish human reasons!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
人類總是入侵我們的村莊，踐踏我們的土地！他們殺害我們的戰士，不是為了榮譽，而是為了人類自私的理由！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Bah! Humans have built their own towns and cities. Do they keep their senseless killing amongst each other?! NO! Humans have to rampage and ravage everything!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哼！人類建立了自己的城鎮和城市。難道他們只在彼此之間進行無意義的殺戮嗎？！不！人類必須四處肆虐，破壞一切！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want
to listen to more,
bring me...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，如果你想繼續聽下去，就給我帶...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again!
I do not think that you can endure much more of this torture.
Bwahahahahahha~!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
我想你大概受不了這種折磨了。
哇哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget!?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你這麼快就忘了嗎！？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的尊重。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
.....
Again, human, you confound me with your stubborness. I see that humans are masochists. Or just like to annoy Orcs by making them count a thousand Jellopies.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
.....
人類啊，你的固執真是讓我困惑。看來人類都是受虐狂。或者就是喜歡讓獸人數一千個傑勒比結晶來惹惱他們。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*sigh* Let me count...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
*嘆氣* 讓我數數...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
.......

[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
九百九十九...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
...A thousand.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
九百九十九...
...一千。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Argh~!
Now where was I?
Oh right, why humans are scum.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
啊~！
現在，我剛才說到哪了？
哦，對了，為什麼人類是垃圾。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
How dare humans think they're so great?! We Orcs have also made contributions to the world!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
人類怎麼敢覺得自己那麼偉大？！我們獸人也對世界做出了貢獻！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Humans may have built cities and towns, but we Orcs have also created our own cave complexes and canals!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
人類也許建立了城市，但我們獸人也創造了我們自己的洞穴群和運河！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs have invented many useful things! Of course, now we've had to keep these things to ourselves. Why? Because of the stupidity and greed of humans!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我們獸人發明了許多有用的東西！當然，現在我們不得不把這些東西藏起來。為什麼？因為人類的愚蠢和貪婪！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs have once constructed a tower for a human, but were then trapped and enslaved there. Needless to say, humans are deserving of our wrath and fury.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我們獸人曾經為人類建造了一座塔，但隨後被困在那裡並被奴役。不用說，人類理應受到我們的憤怒和怒火。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*Sigh*
I don't understand why I am sharing this story about my tribe.
That's enough for today!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
*嘆氣*
我不明白我為什麼要分享關於我部落的故事。
今天就到這裡吧！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Grrr~! If you want to listen longer go bring me ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
咕嚕~！如果你想聽更久，就再給我帶^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget!?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect if
you wish to talk!!
I don't take the 2,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你這麼快就忘了嗎！？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的尊重！！
我不把你給我的2000個傑勒比結晶當回事！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Oh... it's you again.
I can see the Jellopy in your hands, and I'm pretty sure you've brought a thousand again, so let's get this over with.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哦...又是你。
我看到你手裡的傑勒比結晶，我相當確定你又帶來了一千個，所以讓我們快點結束吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*Sigh* I suppose it's time for our conversation.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
*嘆氣* 我想，是時候開始我們的對話了。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Once upon a time, Orcs and humans were allies. I... I miss those times. But it's no use to long for old comraderies. It's impossible to clear up such misunderstandings from ages ago...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
很久以前，獸人和人類曾是盟友。我...我懷念那段時光。但懷念舊日的友誼已無濟於事。要消除那些年代久遠的誤解...是不可能的...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
There are too many wicked humans that have pursued wealth and fame at any cost. They don't understand ideals like honor and loyalty, and use any means to get whatever they want.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
有太多邪惡的人類，為了財富和名聲不擇手段。他們不懂榮譽和忠誠這樣的理想，為了得到想要的東西，什麼手段都使得出來。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Those hateful humans started to get rid of every obstacle that stood between them and what they wanted, not caring if friend or foe stood in their way.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那些令人憎恨的人類開始清除擋在他們和慾望之間的一切障礙，無論是朋友還是敵人，只要擋路就毫不留情。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...I've talked too much already.
That's the end of the conversation for today.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
...我話說得太多了。
今天的對話就到這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want to listen some more, go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，如果你想繼續聽，明天再給我帶^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 3,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你這麼快就忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的尊重。
我不把你給我的3000個傑勒比結晶當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*Sigh...*
You're too tough to get rid of.
Do you really want to listen to me so much...?
Okay... I will tell you a little bit more then.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
*嘆氣...*
你真是難纏。
你真的這麼想聽我說話嗎...？
好吧...那我就再多說一點。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
For us Orcs, victory in battle is the greatest honor.
We fight boldly and fearlessly with our opponent, giving our all in hopes of a fair victory. We would die for victory in battle.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
對我們獸人來說，戰鬥中的勝利是最大的榮耀。
我們勇敢地、無畏地與對手搏鬥，全力以赴，渴望公平的勝利。為了戰鬥中的勝利，我們甘願赴死。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Even after death, we never lose the spirit of combat. It is said that some Orcs that have died unfairly will stand from their graves to seek even more battle.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
即使死後，我們也從未失去戰鬥的精神。據說，有些死得不公平的獸人會從墳墓中站起來，尋求更多的戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The difference between you humans and us is that we would never tolerate foul play in battle. But more importantly, Orcs never, ever retreat. An Orc will always fight till the last breath...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你們人類和我們的區別在於，我們絕不容忍戰鬥中的卑鄙手段。但更重要的是，獸人絕不撤退。獸人會戰鬥到最後一口氣...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Orcs never restore health during battle using your silly medicines. Hmpf. Humans can be so weak, drinking bottles of Potion to keep up in a fight. Oh well, though, I'm not sure if you're the same.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
獸人從不在戰鬥中用你們那些愚蠢的藥水來恢復體力。哼。人類真脆弱，為了在戰鬥中撐下去，還得喝一瓶瓶的藥水。不過，我也不確定你是不是也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want
to listen to me
some more, go and
bring me ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，如果你想繼續聽我說話，明天去給我帶^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 4,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你這麼快就忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的尊重。
我不把你給我的4000個傑勒比結晶當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
What the...! Don't you know when to stop? I do not believe a human would like to hear about Orcs so much. But...
We Orcs are a proud race, and I shall oblige.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
該死的...！你不知道適可而止嗎？我不相信會有人類這麼想聽關於獸人的事。但是...
我們獸人是一個驕傲的種族，我會滿足你的要求。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We only select the strongest of our tribe to become warriors. When Orcs reach adulthood, they are sent to the forest to survive alone in its environment.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我們只挑選部落中最強壯的個體成為戰士。當獸人成年後，它們會被送入森林，獨自在那裡生存。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Those Orcs that come back alive are recognized as true members of the tribe. The strongest males are chosen to become Orc Warriors, and the strongest females are chosen as Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那些活著回來的獸人會被承認為部落的真正成員。最強的雄性會被選為獸人戰士，最強的雌性會被選為獸人女士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Orcs that have proven to have good sight and dexterity are given bows and arrows and become Orc Archers.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那些被證明擁有良好視力和敏捷性的獸人，會被授予弓箭，成為獸人弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs have a special training course called 'The Trial of Fire.' If any Orc Warrior passes this course, he will be protected by our fire god...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我們獸人有一項特殊的訓練課程，叫做“火之試煉”。如果任何獸人戰士通過了這項課程，他將受到我們火神的庇護...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
That Orc will have stronger physical strength and abilities than normal Orc Warriors. These warriors are known as High Orcs.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那個獸人將擁有比普通獸人戰士更強的體力和能力。這些戰士被稱為獸人戰士長。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm, well to you humans, we may all look the same, but we Orcs can tell each other apart. How about you, human? Do I look the same as every Warrior outside to you?
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯，在你們人類眼裡，我們可能都長得差不多，但我們獸人之間能互相分辨。那麼你呢，人類？在你眼裡，我和外面的每個戰士看起來都一樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
If you want to
listen longer,
go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
好了...
如果你想繼續聽，明天再來給我^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 5,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
想跟我說話就拿出點誠意來。
我可沒把你給我的那5000個傑勒比結晶當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I expected you to quit by now. But I was wrong, because you're here once again. We made a deal and I will keep my promise.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我以為你早就放棄了。但我錯了，因為你又來了。我們既然達成了約定，我就會信守承諾。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Last time, we were
talking about our
warriors...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
上次，我們聊到了我們的戰士...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Sometimes, a few Orcs are born among us, possessing phenomenal strength and talent. It is rumored that they could compete with 10,000 warriors at a time...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
有時候，我們中間會誕生一些擁有非凡力量和天賦的獸人。據說他們能同時對抗一萬名戰士...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
They are the best warriors of the Orc tribe, and are known to you as Orc Heroes. Not only are they the strongest ones among us, but they also our leaders in battle.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
他們是獸人部落中最強的戰士，也就是你們所說的獸人英雄。他們不僅是我們中最強的，也是我們在戰場上的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
As proof of their status, Orc Heroes are given Vouchers of Orcish Hero, as well as special swords that are only allowed to be used by our heroes.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
作為地位的象徵，獸人英雄會被授予獸人英雄之證，以及只有我們英雄才能使用的特別的劍。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
That sword can tear the sky, sever the earth and make a waterfall flow backwards.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那把劍能撕裂天空，斬斷大地，甚至能讓瀑布倒流。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The special helmet that is only worn by Orc Heroes represents the power and honor of the Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
只有獸人英雄才能佩戴的特殊頭盔，象徵著獸人戰士的力量與榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Well, humans rarely get the chance to see this helmet unless they're in battle with an Orc Hero themselves...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯，人類很少有機會看到這頂頭盔，除非他們親自與獸人英雄交戰...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want
to listen longer,
go and bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
好了，如果你想繼續聽，明天再來給我^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
想跟我說話就拿出點誠意來。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I don't take the 6,000 jellopies you have given to me that seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我可沒把你給我的那6000個傑勒比結晶當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Oh, hello. You're back.
Go ahead and put the 1000 Jellopies over there on the table by the skulls.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哦，你好。你回來了。
把那1000個傑勒比結晶放到那邊骷髏旁邊的桌子上吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Ah yes, we were talking about Orc Heroes. Now, unlike Orc Heroes who are blessed with might from the day they were born, there are older, seasoned warriors that have managed to survive many years of combat.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
啊對，我們剛才聊到了獸人英雄。不過，與那些天生擁有神力的獸人英雄不同，還有一些年長且經驗豐富的戰士，他們在多年的戰鬥中倖存了下來。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
To Orc Warriors, we do not see age as weakness. We look up to old warriors as our trainers due to their experience in battle and their fighting skills.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
對於獸人戰士來說，我們並不認為年齡意味著衰弱。我們尊敬老戰士，視他們為導師，因為他們擁有豐富的戰鬥經驗和精湛的武藝。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Those old warriors have shown outstanding fighting abilities, even without the use of weapons.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
這些老戰士展現了卓越的戰鬥力，即使不使用武器也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
They could endure in battle for at least few days without axes. When you get to a certain fighting skill level, weapons can actually become a burden...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
他們能在沒有戰斧的情況下，在戰鬥中堅持好幾天。當武藝達到一定境界時，武器反而會成為負擔...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Among those well-experienced warriors, the greatest one of all is given the title of Orc Lord, and is given our respect as the leader of our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
在這些經驗豐富的戰士中，最偉大的一位會被授予獸人酋長的頭銜，並受到我們作為部落首領的尊敬。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Every Orc can recognize him by his distinguished helm with the three horns.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
每個獸人都能通過他頭上那頂長著三隻角的獨特頭盔認出他。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
If you want to
listen longer,
go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
好了...
如果你想繼續聽，明天再來給我^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 7,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的敬意。
你給我的7000個傑勒比結晶，我可沒當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
It's been a while I've seen such a determined human such as yourself. Just leave the Jellopy near the bed.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
好久沒見過像你這樣意志堅定的人類了。把傑勒比結晶放在床邊就好。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
Let me tell you
more about the
Orc Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那麼...
讓我再告訴你一些關於獸人部落的事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although I don't like to admit it, there are cowardly Orcs that run away from battle, or fight using dishonorable methods.
Needless to say, they have brought shame and disgrace to our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
雖然我不願承認，但確實有一些懦弱的獸人，他們會在戰鬥中逃跑，或者使用卑鄙的手段。
不用說，他們給部落帶來了恥辱和汙名。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
A curse is placed on those dishonorable Orcs so that they can be singled out by the tribe and banished from the village.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那些不光彩的獸人會被施加詛咒，以便被部落識別出來，並驅逐出村莊。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You may recognize those cursed Orcs by their shrunken bodies and long teeth.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你可以通過他們萎縮的身體和長長的牙齒認出那些被詛咒的獸人。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We call these cursed Orcs Zenorc. They are forced to live inside of caves or dungeons, away from from honorable Orcs. It's difficult to believe that Zenorcs were once one of us...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我們稱這些被詛咒的獸人為茲諾克。他們被迫生活在洞穴或地下城深處，遠離光榮的獸人。很難相信茲諾克曾經也是我們的族人...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I don't think there is a curse which transforms humans into a totally ugly creature depending on their deeds. So it is difficult to tell which humans are honorable...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我不認為存在一種詛咒，會根據人類的行為將他們變成醜陋的生物。所以很難分辨哪些人類是光榮的...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
If you want
to hear more,
go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那麼...
如果你想聽更多，明天再來給我^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 8,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的敬意。
你給我的8000個傑勒比結晶，我可沒當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
With these...
You have brought me 10,000 Jellopies. I must say that I am impressed. Since you have shown me your respect, I will repay you with my honesty.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
有了這些...
你一共給了我10000個傑勒比結晶。我必須說，我很受感動。既然你向我展示了敬意，我也會以誠實回報你。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Considering the stories about my tribe, it's enough for me if you just listen. However, merely listening is totally different from having the experience as your own.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
考慮到關於我部落的故事，只要你肯聽就足夠了。然而，僅僅傾聽與親身經歷是完全不同的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I suggest you that you experience more battles with the many different Orcs out there. That's the best way of understanding and learning about the Orc tribe.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我建議你多去和外面各種各樣的獸人戰鬥。這是瞭解和認識獸人部落的最好方式。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
This is a small token of my gratitue. This axe used to aid me in many battles and is very precious to me. I hope you will take care of this.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
這是我的一點小小謝意。這把斧頭曾幫助我在許多戰鬥中獲勝，對我來說非常珍貴。希望你能好好保管它。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You have made a lot of effort to show me respect, despite being a human. Now, if you want to learn more about Orcs, feel free to come back anytime, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
作為一個人類，你付出了很多努力來向我表示敬意。現在，如果你想了解更多關於獸人的事，隨時歡迎回來，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take 9,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你忘了嗎？
^FF00001000個傑勒比結晶^000000！
如果你想說話，就表現出你的敬意。
你給我的9000個傑勒比結晶，我可沒當回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You have made a lot of effort to show me your respect. Now, if you want to learn more about Orcs, feel free to come back anytime, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你付出了很多努力來向我表示敬意。現在，如果你想了解更多關於獸人的事，隨時歡迎回來，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Oh, I see you've taken my advice and have been meeting many other Orcs through battle.
You must have learned much about the Orc's spirit of battle by seeing it for yourself firsthand.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哦，看來你聽從了我的建議，通過戰鬥結識了許多其他獸人。
親眼見證這一切，你一定對獸人的戰鬥精神有了深刻的瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
These Orchish Vouchers you have been collecting are the true token of Orc warriors. We recognize an Orc who won over 1,000 battles as a true Orc Warrior.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你收集的這些獸人戰士之證，是真正的獸人戰士的象徵。我們承認贏得1000場戰鬥的獸人為真正的獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Still...
You're a human, so I don't give we can give you that honor so easily...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
不過...
你是人類，所以我不能輕易給你這份榮譽...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Alright...
Go win over 10,000 battles.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
好吧...
去贏得10000場戰鬥吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Then, I'm sure you can be granted status as a real Orc warrior. But, make sure you are fighting for honorable purposes, and that you have no other motive.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那樣，我相信你就能獲得真正的獸人戰士的地位。但是，請確保你是為了榮譽而戰，沒有其他目的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You only achieve honor by winning battles. Even among Orcs, I'm sure you can prove your battle prowess by defeating 10,000 Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
只有通過贏得戰鬥才能獲得榮譽。即使是在獸人中，我相信你也能通過擊敗10000名獸人戰士來證明你的戰鬥實力。

scripts.text: I don't think that is necessary.
scripts.translation: 我覺得沒有必要

scripts.text: I will win 10,000 battles!
scripts.translation: 我會贏得10000場戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I see. I will not force you to choose what I wish to see you do. I respect your decision.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我明白了。我不會強迫你選擇我希望你做的事。我尊重你的決定。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although...
I wished for other Orcs to see and understand that not all humans are wicked and selfish.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
雖然...
我希望其他獸人能看到並理解，並非所有人類都是邪惡和自私的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Ah, spoken like a true warrior. Alright then, go forth and do battle with others of my tribe, and bring me 10,000 Orcish Vouchers.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
啊，像個真正的戰士一樣說話。好吧，那就去吧，與我部落的其他人戰鬥，並給我帶來10000個獸人戰士之證。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I took 100 Orcish Voucher from you now. Now, fight and fight until you have defeated 10,000 more Orc Warriors so that the whole tribe will have to recognize you!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我現在從你這裡拿了100個獸人戰士之證。現在，繼續戰鬥，直到你擊敗另外10000名獸人戰士，讓整個部落都承認你！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm? You don't seem to understand our way of life completely. It's strange that you are so curious about other races, human.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯？你似乎沒有完全理解我們的生活方式。作為一個人類，你對其他種族如此好奇，真是奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The best way of understanding the Orc tribe is to do battle with them. By competing in power and skills, eventually you will understand and respect your opponent.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
理解獸人部落的最好方式就是與他們戰鬥。通過力量和技巧的較量，最終你會理解並尊重你的對手。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
So, go outside and fight.
Although you may be learning theory by talking with me, you must experience our way of life for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
所以，出去戰鬥吧。
雖然你可以通過與我交談來學習理論，但你必須親自體驗我們的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm? You don't seem to understand our way of life completely. It's strange that you are so curious about other races, human.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯？你似乎沒有完全理解我們的生活方式。作為一個人類，你對其他種族如此好奇，真是奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You've come back...
It doesn't seem that you've accomplished your goal yet, but I do not expect you to defeat 10,000 Orc Warriors so easily.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你回來了...
看起來你還沒有達成目標，但我也不指望你能輕易擊敗10000名獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrrior]
If you wish, you may rest here. {0} victories over Orc Warriors are recognized by our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
如果你願意，可以在這裡休息。{0}場對獸人戰士的勝利已被我們部落認可。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Do you wish to
record your current
victory with me?
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你想讓我記錄你目前的勝利嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，請記錄

scripts.text: I will do it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再做

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I hope you will
continue your efforts
in understanding the Orc
way of life through battle.
Don't give up.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我希望你能繼續努力，通過戰鬥來理解獸人的生活方式。
不要放棄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
There are {0} battles ahead of you before you reach your goal. I understand the difficulty of this challenge, but I hope you make it.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
距離你達成目標還有{0}場戰鬥。我理解這個挑戰的難度，但我希望你能成功。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
You won over
10,000 battles
with Orcs.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在...
你贏得了10000場與獸人的戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
For a human, accomplishing such a feat is truly astonishing. Through all of that fighting, I'm sure that you have learned both good and bad things about my tribe.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
作為一個人類，能完成這樣的壯舉，真是令人驚歎。經歷了這麼多戰鬥，我相信你一定了解了我部族的許多事情，無論好壞。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although you're a
human, you have
demonstrated incredible
bravery and honor...
I shall grant you true
Orc Warrior status!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
雖然你是人類，但你展現了非凡的勇氣與榮譽...
我將授予你真正的獸人戰士身份！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You are now...
an Orc Warrior!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你現在是...
獸人戰士了！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You are now...
an Orc Lady!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你現在是...
獸人女子了！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
This is a present for you. I am not sure if it will fit to your head or not, but try it. If your head is too big to wear this, I suggest that you carry this with you.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
這是給你的禮物。我不確定它是否適合你的頭，但請試試看。如果你的頭太大戴不上，我建議你就把它帶在身邊。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
As an Orc Warrior,
I will now give you
an Orcish Voucher
of your very own.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
作為獸人戰士，我現在將頒發給你一張專屬的獸人戰士之證。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although it doesn't look different from the others, please keep this with care. You can only be recognized as an Orc warrior with this.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
雖然它看起來和其他的沒什麼不同，但請妥善保管。只有持有它，你才會被承認為獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, you may go back to where you have come from. Come drop by whenever my tribe comes to your mind.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，你可以回到你來的地方了。每當想起我的部族，歡迎隨時回來看看。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
As you are now one who feels the true intent of the opponent after endless battles, I will now return you to the battleground.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
既然你在無盡的戰鬥中，已經能夠感知對手真正的意圖，那麼我現在就送你回到戰場。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I see, do as you wish.
I will be really disappointed in you if you quit in a challenge you have undertaken.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
我明白了，隨你便吧。
如果你放棄了已經開始的挑戰，我會對你非常失望的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Come take a rest here.
You have won {0} victories over Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
來這裡休息一下吧。
你擊敗了{0}名獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm? You don't think you cannot come back to where you originally came, just because now you're an Orc Warrior, do you? Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯？你不會以為既然成為了獸人戰士，就不能回到原來的地方了吧？哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior...
May a fresh
light be with
you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
戰士...
願新的光芒伴隨你征戰沙場。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Show your opponents your indomitable spirit. Take pride in being a human that has been given the title of Orc Warrior!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
向你的對手展示你不屈的精神。為身為人類卻獲得獸人戰士這一稱號而感到自豪吧！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
My my...
Are you still
hungry for blood...?
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
哎呀...
你還渴望鮮血...嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You don't seem to be satisfied even after being recognized as a warrior. But... I suppose the path of the warrior is to seek new and more difficult challenges.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
即使被承認為戰士，你似乎也不滿足。不過...我想，戰士的道路就是不斷尋求新的、更艱難的挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Okay, would you like to go through another test? It may reduce all your effort in coming here to nothing. Even seasoned Orc Warriors fear taking this test.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
好吧，你想再接受一次考驗嗎？這可能會讓你之前的努力付諸東流。即使是經驗豐富的獸人戰士，也畏懼接受這項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
But, since you're an exceptional case, it might be possible for you to accomplish...
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
不過，既然你是特例，也許你能成功...

scripts.text: I am already satisfied.
scripts.translation: 我已經心滿意足了

scripts.text: ...I will take this challenge.
scripts.translation: ...我會接受這個挑戰

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Yes, that's a good
attitude. Sometimes,
you must accept your
limitations, or that
you cannot beat
certain opponents.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
是的，這是很好的態度。
有時候，你必須接受自己的侷限，或者承認自己無法戰勝某些對手。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Excellent, I admire your enthusiasm. This is a very rare chance to do battle with the strongest Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
很好，我很欣賞你的熱情。
這是一個非常罕見的機會，可以與最強的獸人英雄們戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Go fight with 100 Orc Heroes and bring me the tokens of the battles you have endured. Even if you're an excellent warrior, I assure you this test will be the hardest one you'll ever get.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
去與100名獸人英雄戰鬥，並帶給我你經歷戰鬥的憑證。
即使你是優秀的戰士，我向你保證，這將是你遇到的最艱難考驗。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, go, warrior! I believe that you have a chance to succeed. Fight with 100 Orc Heroes, and I will grant you, a human, recognition as an Orc Hero!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，去吧，戰士！
我相信你有成功的機會。
與100名獸人英雄戰鬥，我將授予你，一個人類，獸人英雄的認可！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior, may a fresh light be with you in battle. Show your opponents your indomitable spirit. Take pride in being a human that has been given the title of Orc Warrior!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
戰士，願新的光芒伴隨你戰鬥。
向你的對手展示你不可征服的精神。
為身為被賦予獸人戰士稱號的人類而自豪吧！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Ah...
I knew you would succeed!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
啊...
我就知道你能成功！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The Orc Heroes who were defeated by you also must have recognized your courage. Thank you, human, for showing us what is true strength.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
被你擊敗的獸人英雄們，想必也認可了你的勇氣。
謝謝你，人類，向我們展示了什麼是真正的力量。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
On behalf of
the Orc tribe,
let me pay
you homage.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
代表獸人部族，讓我向你致敬。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, make one last choice. What would you do with those Heroic Emblems? They might not be valuable to you humans, but for Orcs, they are treasured by those who own them.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，做最後的選擇。
你要如何處理那些獸人英雄之證？
它們可能對你們人類沒有太大價值，但對獸人來說，它們是持有者珍視之物。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Since you are the victor of those battles, you have every right to keep them. But you could also return them to the Orc Heroes, meaning that you wish to meet them in battle once again.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
既然你是那些戰鬥的勝利者，你完全有權保留它們。
但你也可以將它們歸還給獸人英雄，這意味著你希望再次與他們戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, what would
you want to do
with the vouchers?
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
現在，你想如何處理這些憑證？

scripts.text: I want to keep them.
scripts.translation: 我想保留它們

scripts.text: I shall return them to the Orc Heroes.
scripts.translation: 我會將它們歸還給獸人英雄

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Yes, that's
not bad...
Not bad at all.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
是的，這很不錯...
非常棒。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nobody has the right to tell you what you can or cannot do. Please keep them as a memory of your victory.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
沒有人有權告訴你什麼能做或不能做。
請保留它們，作為你勝利的紀念。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
What a great attitude for a warrior...! It will be a model to other Orcs to show respect to opponents that you have defeated!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
多麼偉大的戰士態度...！
這將向其他獸人展示，如何尊重你擊敗的對手！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You deserve to be an Orc Hero, the most powerful Orc warrior! As of today, you are now an Orc Hero!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
你配得上成為獸人英雄，最強大的獸人戰士！
從今天起，你成為了獸人英雄！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
This is a sword only given to our heroes. I am not sure if you can use this or not, but as an Orc Hero, you're obligated to carry this with you always.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
這是一把只授予我們英雄的劍。
我不確定你是否能使用它，但作為獸人英雄，你有義務時刻攜帶它。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now that you
are an Orc Hero,
let me give you
your own Heroic
Emblem.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
既然你成為了獸人英雄，讓我給你你自己的獸人英雄之證。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although it doesn't look different from the others, I hope you will keep it with care. You can only be recognized as an Orc Hero with this token.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
雖然它看起來與其他的一樣，但我希望你好好保管它。
只有持有這個憑證，你才能被認可為獸人英雄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Then, you may leave now....
A human who has a better understanding than other humans. One who showed others power regardless of the race, I leave you to the future of Chaos.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
那麼，你可以離開了...
一個比其他人更懂得道理的人類。一個不分種族、向他人展示力量的人，我將混沌的未來託付給你。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm...
Struggling, are you?
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯...
你在掙扎嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Well, Orc Hero is held in high regard by other Orcs for their great power. As a human, you will probably have difficulty in dealing with him.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
嗯，獸人英雄因其強大的力量而受到其他獸人的尊敬。作為人類，你大概很難對付他。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
However, you made the decision to go through with this test! Still, there's no need to rush it. Life is an endless series of battles, so the combat will come.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
不過，你決定接受這項考驗！儘管如此，也不必急於求成。生命是一場無盡的戰鬥，戰鬥總會到來。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior, where did you leave your Heroic Emblem? Without the token, I cannot recognize you as an Orc Hero. Please find it and keep it with you anywhere you go.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
戰士，你把獸人英雄之證放在哪裡了？沒有這個憑證，我無法認可你是獸人英雄。請找到它，並隨身攜帶。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior, where did you leave your sword? Without the sword, I cannot recognize you as an Orc Hero. Please find it and keep it with you anywhere you go.
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
戰士，你把劍放在哪裡了？沒有這把劍，我無法認可你是獸人英雄。請找到它，並隨身攜帶。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The most
powerful warrior...
Orc Hero!
That's who you are!
May God be with you in battle!
scripts.translation:
[獸人戰士]
最強大的戰士...
獸人英雄！
那就是你！
願神在戰鬥中與你同在！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請在減輕負重後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Stop bugging me
and get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
別煩我了，快滾！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
If you wish to challenge me, wait inside the forest at the west. I'm not in the mood to deal with humans right now.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
如果你想挑戰我，去西邊的森林裡等著。我現在沒心情應付人類。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Now, hurry
up and scram!!
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
現在，趕緊滾蛋！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hm, are you the human who was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
嗯，你就是那個被授予獸人英雄身份的人類嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I hope you know the meaning of returning my Emblem. I expect that we will meet again on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
我希望你知道歸還我徽章的意義。我期待我們在戰場上再次相遇。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Wait...
Isn't that an Orc Warrior's Helm...?
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
等等...
那不是獸人戰士的頭盔嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Wait a second...
It's not! Ha...!
Interesting!
That's very
interesting.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
等一下...
不是！哈...！
有意思！
非常有意思。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I guess you don't know what's so special about this particular helm...
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
看來你不知道這頂頭盔有什麼特別之處...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
It actually belonged to one of our Orc Lords who was defeated by a human. He was so furious about losing that he broke the middle horn and threw it away!
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
它其實屬於我們的一位獸人酋長，他被一個人類擊敗了。他因為戰敗而大怒，折斷了中間的角，然後把它扔掉了！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I was told that it somehow ended in the hands of a human, but I didn't know it was you, the human Orc Hero.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
我聽說它不知怎麼落到了人類手裡，但我沒想到是你，人類獸人英雄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Alright, that belongs to the Orc Lord. I mean, even though it's now yours, it was given to you by mistake.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
好吧，那是獸人酋長的東西。我是說，雖然現在它是你的，但它是被錯誤地給你的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Would you mind giving the item back to its owner, my human Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
你介意把這件物品歸還給它的主人嗎，我的人類獸人英雄？

scripts.text: Yes, I mind.
scripts.translation: 介意

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Wow, you're so stubborn! Just treat the helm with care, and wear it with respect. Recognize that it has a long history...
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
哇，你真是固執！好好對待這頂頭盔，戴著它要心懷敬意。要知道它有著悠久的歷史...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Good, that's a good decision. I will give this back to him. Muhahahahaha... I didn't expect to see this thing again.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
很好，這是個明智的決定。我會把它還給他。穆哈哈哈哈哈...沒想到還能再見到這東西。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Okay...
Let me give you
something useful!
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
好吧...
讓我給你點有用的東西！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Although you're a human, you're an Orc Hero amongst us now, so you should have a helm suitable for your position...
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
雖然你是人類，但現在你也是我們中的獸人英雄，所以你應該有一頂符合你身份的頭盔...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
There you go. I marked a small indication on it. So wear this helm from now on. Do you understand? My human Orc Hero.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
給你。我在上面做了個小標記。從今以後就戴這頂頭盔吧。明白嗎？我的人類獸人英雄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hm, are you the human who was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
嗯，你就是那個被授予獸人英雄身份的人類嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
 I hope you know the meaning of returning my Emblem. I expect that we will meet again on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
我希望你知道歸還我徽章的意義。我期待在戰場上再次與你相遇。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hm, are you the human that was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
嗯，你是那個被授予獸人英雄稱號的人類嗎？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hmpf, I'm not convinced. Are you really the one who gave us our Emblems back? I don't think I can trust you...
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
哼，我不信。你真的是把徽章還給我們的人嗎？我覺得我沒法信任你...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Yeh, you would think I'd remember getting whupped by an ugly human, but I tend not to remember faces when I'm too busy getting whomped on.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
是啊，你肯定以為我會記得被一個醜陋的人類揍了一頓，但我忙著捱揍的時候，通常記不住臉。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I refuse to
acknowledge someone
like you who forgets
our most basic customs!
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
我拒絕承認像你這樣忘記我們最基本習俗的人！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Grrrr...
Come on!
Let's meet outside west of the forest, and I'll test your strength again!
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
咕嚕嚕...
來吧！
到森林西邊外面來，我再測試一下你的實力！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Muhahahaha~
You're the
strangest human
I've ever met.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
穆哈哈哈哈哈~
你是我見過的最奇怪的人類。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I like you,
human, I like you.
scripts.translation:
[獸人英雄]
我喜歡你，人類，我喜歡你。
